eligibility: 110 panel positions for Data Entry Operator — Panchkula 50, Gurugram 10, Jhajjar 10, Karnal 10, Palwal 10, Rewari 10, Sonepat 10. The advertisement is Hartron/ICTET/2026-27/04, issued 12 November 2026. Apply for only ONE district — a candidate applying for more than one district is not allowed.

Qualification — any one of these, plus the mandatory typing speed: (1) 10+2 with 50% marks, or Graduation, with an 'O' Level / one-year computer course from a recognised institution; (2) three-year Diploma in any stream, BCA, or B.Sc (Computer Science/IT); (3) Matriculation with 50% marks + two-year Diploma in Office Management and Computer Applications; (4) post-matric one-year ITI course in Stenography/NCVT with 60% marks.
Mandatory data punching speed: 9,000 key depressions per hour in English (150 per minute, about 30 words per minute).
Age 18–42 years as on 1 November 2026. Relaxation for SC, BC-A, BC-B, PwBD and ex-servicemen candidates as per Haryana government reservation policy.

Selection: a two-part practical computer examination — Part I: online multiple-choice test on computer awareness, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Internet, Networking and basic IT concepts; Part II: data entry/typing speed test at the 9,000 key-depressions-per-hour benchmark. Remuneration ₹18,000 per month on deployment. The panel is valid for 2 years from the date of result publication (extendable if required). This panel updation is for deployment to indenting Haryana government departments and organisations, including Kurukshetra University.

योग्यता — इनमें से कोई एक, साथ में अनिवार्य टाइपिंग गति: (1) 50% अंकों के साथ 10+2, या स्नातक, साथ में मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थान से 'O' लेवल / एक-साला कंप्यूटर कोर्स; (2) किसी भी stream में तीन-साला डिप्लोमा, BCA, या B.Sc (कंप्यूटर साइंस/IT); (3) 50% अंकों के साथ मैट्रिक + ऑफिस मैनेजमेंट और कंप्यूटर एप्लीकेशन्स में दो-साला डिप्लोमा; (4) 60% अंकों के साथ पोस्ट-मैट्रिक एक-साला ITI कोर्स (स्टेनोग्राफी/NCVT)।

चयन: दो-भाग वाली व्यावहारिक कंप्यूटर परीक्षा — भाग I: कंप्यूटर जागरूकता, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), इंटरनेट, नेटवर्किंग और बुनियादी IT अवधारणाओं पर ऑनलाइन बहुविकल्पीय परीक्षा; भाग II: 9,000 key depressions प्रति घंटे के benchmark पर डेटा एंट्री/टाइपिंग गति परीक्षा। परीक्षाएँ सिर्फ़ IDDC, अंबाला और HMSDC, गुरुग्राम में होंगी। Admit card 1 दिसंबर 2026 से download किए जा सकते हैं; परीक्षा दिसंबर 2026 में है।

Deployment पर पारिश्रमिक ₹18,000 प्रति माह। पैनल परिणाम प्रकाशन की तिथि से 2 साल के लिए वैध है (आवश्यकता होने पर बढ़ाया जा सकता है)। यह पैनल updation हरियाणा सरकारी विभागों और संस्थाओं — कुरुक्षेत्र विश्वविद्यालय सहित — में deployment के लिए है।

donts: Do not submit a second application if you already applied in the original window — use the cadre-option step instead.
Do not wait for the last day — the portal slows down badly in the final hours.
Do not assume every cadre needs the same qualification — Staff Nurse, Talathi, Craft Instructor and Clerk-Typist each have their own rules.
Do not pay by challan — that option has been withdrawn; pay online only.
dos: Apply on mpsconline.gov.in between 13 and 27 November 2026 — inside your login, against Advt. No. 017/2026.
If you applied earlier, log in and choose the newly added cadres instead of filing a fresh application.
Check the cadre-wise qualification in the notification before paying the fee — it changes completely from one cadre to the next.
Pay the fee online by 30 November 2026, 11:59 PM — challan payment is no longer accepted.
Note the age-reckoning date for your cadre — 1 October 2026 for original cadres, 27 November 2026 for some new ones.
eligibility: 16,717 Group C posts across 27 cadres under Advt. No. 017/2026 — the biggest cadres are Clerk-Typist 3,966, Staff Nurse (Adhiparicharika) 3,911, Talathi 1,840, Craft Instructor 1,388 and Assistant Agriculture Officer 1,203. Note honestly: the cadre-wise table printed in some summaries adds up to 16,256, not 16,717 — the Commission's corrigendum total of 16,717 governs, and more posts may still be added until the prelims result.

This is a re-opened window: the exam was first advertised on 25 June 2026 with 2,619 posts, then revised to 5,707, and a corrigendum dated 6 November 2026 (Ref. No. CMA-0426/P.K.42/2026/Jahirat) raised it to 16,717 with 11,010 newly requisitioned posts. Fresh candidates can apply, and already-registered candidates can opt for the new cadres, from 13 November 2026 (2 PM) to 27 November 2026 (11:59 PM).

Age 18–43 years, with a one-year upper-age relaxation granted by the General Administration Department's Government Resolution dated 5 November 2026. The age-reckoning date is 1 October 2026 for the cadres in the original advertisement, and 27 November 2026 for some newly added cadres such as Civil Engineering Assistant, Craft Instructor, Staff Nurse and Storekeeper.

Qualification is cadre-wise: Clerk-Typist — Bachelor's degree from a recognised university plus the prescribed typing qualification; Staff Nurse — GNM or B.Sc Nursing; Talathi — Bachelor's degree; Craft Instructor — ITI in the trade; Assistant Agriculture Officer — degree in Agriculture. Check the cadre-wise qualification in the notification before paying the fee.

Selection: Combined Preliminary Examination (offline, OMR) on 24 January 2027, followed by the Main Examination for shortlisted candidates. The prelims was earlier scheduled for 3 January 2027 and has been moved to 24 January 2027.

extra_faq.a: 16,717 posts across 27 cadres, as per the corrigendum dated 6 November 2026 — up from 5,707 earlier. The biggest cadres are Clerk-Typist (3,966), Staff Nurse (3,911) and Talathi (1,840). Note: the cadre-wise table in some summaries adds up to 16,256; the Commission's corrigendum total of 16,717 governs.

extra_faq.a: No. Log in to mpsconline.gov.in, open Advt. No. 017/2026 and choose the newly added cadres through the cadre-option step. Do not submit a fresh application.
extra_faq.q: I applied in the original MPSC Group C window. Do I need to apply again?

extra_faq.a: Fresh applications and cadre options close on 27 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The exam fee (₹394 General / ₹294 SC/ST) can be paid online until 30 November 2026 at 11:59 PM; challan payment has been withdrawn.
extra_faq.q: What is the last date to apply and pay the fee for MPSC Group C 2026?

extra_faq.a: The Combined Preliminary Examination (offline, OMR) is on 24 January 2027. It was earlier scheduled for 3 January 2027 and was moved by the 6 November 2026 corrigendum.

eligibility: Advt. No. 017/2026 के तहत 27 कैडरों में 16,717 ग्रुप C पद — सबसे बड़े कैडर क्लर्क-टाइपिस्ट 3,966, स्टाफ नर्स (अधिपरिचारिका) 3,911, तलाठी 1,840, क्राफ्ट इंस्ट्रक्टर 1,388 और सहायक कृषि अधिकारी 1,203 हैं। ईमानदारी से नोट करें: कुछ summaries में छपी कैडर-वार तालिका का योग 16,256 होता है, 16,717 नहीं — आयोग का corrigendum वाला कुल 16,717 ही मान्य है, और prelims के result तक और पद जुड़ सकते हैं।

यह दोबारा खुली हुई window है: परीक्षा पहले 25 जून 2026 को 2,619 पदों के साथ विज्ञापित हुई थी, फिर 5,707 हुई, और 6 नवंबर 2026 के corrigendum (Ref. No. CMA-0426/P.K.42/2026/Jahirat) से 11,010 नए requisitioned पद जुड़कर कुल 16,717 हो गए। नए उम्मीदवार apply कर सकते हैं और पहले से registered उम्मीदवार नए cadres के options चुन सकते हैं — 13 नवंबर 2026 (दोपहर 2 बजे) से 27 नवंबर 2026 (रात 11:59) तक।

उम्र 18–43 वर्ष, साथ में सामान्य प्रशासन विभाग के 5 नवंबर 2026 के शासनादेश से ऊपरी उम्र-सीमा में एक साल की छूट। उम्र गिनने की तारीख मूल विज्ञापन वाले कैडरों के लिए 1 अक्टूबर 2026 है, और कुछ नए कैडरों (सिविल इंजीनियरिंग असिस्टेंट, क्राफ्ट इंस्ट्रक्टर, स्टाफ नर्स, स्टोरकीपर) के लिए 27 नवंबर 2026 है।

योग्यता कैडर के हिसाब से है: क्लर्क-टाइपिस्ट — मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय से स्नातक डिग्री + निर्धारित टाइपिंग योग्यता; स्टाफ नर्स — GNM या B.Sc नर्सिंग; तलाठी — स्नातक डिग्री; क्राफ्ट इंस्ट्रक्टर — ट्रेड में ITI; सहायक कृषि अधिकारी — कृषि में डिग्री। शुल्क भरने से पहले अधिसूचना में अपने कैडर की योग्यता ज़रूर जाँचो।
चयन: संयुक्त प्रारंभिक परीक्षा (ऑफलाइन, OMR) 24 जनवरी 2027 को, फिर shortlisted उम्मीदवारों की मुख्य परीक्षा। Prelims पहले 3 जनवरी 2027 को थी, 6 नवंबर 2026 के corrigendum से 24 जनवरी 2027 कर दी गई है।

extra_faq.a: 27 कैडरों में 16,717 पद, 6 नवंबर 2026 के corrigendum के अनुसार — पहले 5,707 थे। सबसे बड़े कैडर क्लर्क-टाइपिस्ट (3,966), स्टाफ नर्स (3,911) और तलाठी (1,840) हैं। नोट करें: कुछ summaries की कैडर-वार तालिका का योग 16,256 होता है; आयोग का corrigendum वाला कुल 16,717 ही मान्य है।
extra_faq.q: MPSC ग्रुप C 2026 में कितनी रिक्तियाँ हैं?

extra_faq.a: नहीं। mpsconline.gov.in पर login करके Advt. No. 017/2026 खोलो और cadre-option step से नए cadres चुनो। Fresh application मत भरो।
extra_faq.q: मैंने MPSC ग्रुप C की पुरानी window में apply किया था। क्या दोबारा apply करना होगा?

extra_faq.a: Fresh application और cadre options 27 नवंबर 2026, रात 11:59 तक। परीक्षा शुल्क (₹394 सामान्य / ₹294 SC/ST) ऑनलाइन 30 नवंबर 2026, रात 11:59 तक भरा जा सकता है; चालान से भुगतान बंद है।
extra_faq.q: MPSC ग्रुप C 2026 के लिए apply और शुल्क की अंतिम तिथि क्या है?

extra_faq.a: संयुक्त प्रारंभिक परीक्षा (ऑफलाइन, OMR) 24 जनवरी 2027 को है। पहले यह 3 जनवरी 2027 को थी, 6 नवंबर 2026 के corrigendum से बदलकर 24 जनवरी 2027 कर दी गई है।
extra_faq.q: MPSC ग्रुप C prelims परीक्षा कब है?

donts: Do not treat the MT post as a direct permanent job — it is 1 year of training first, then absorption as Deputy Manager.
Do not apply for both MT and Manager — only the latest application is kept and the other fee is forfeited.
Do not apply for Manager without 4 years of post-qualification experience — it is compulsory.
Do not wait for the last day — the window is only 15 days (27 November to 11 December).
dos: Apply only on eximbankindia.in/careers from 27 November 2026 — the link goes live that day.
Choose only ONE post — MT or Manager — your single best-matching one.
Check the 60% marks rule for your qualifying degree before paying the fee.
Keep your photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration scans ready in the portal's format.
Prepare for a subjective (descriptive) professional-knowledge paper — it is not an MCQ test.

donts: Do not mistake OTR for an application — OTR alone does not enter you in this recruitment.
Do not pay only the processing fee — the application is rejected if the exam fee is unpaid (unless you are unemployed).

dos: Complete your OTR on tgpsc.gov.in first, then file a separate online application for Notification No. 07/G/ES/2026.
Check whether your degree had Statistics as a main subject or as a paper in any year — before paying the fee.
Pay BOTH fees — processing fee and the ₹80 exam fee (unless you are unemployed, in which case the exam fee is exempt).
Apply before 27 November 2026, 5:00 PM — the deadline is a fixed time, not midnight.
Check the 95% local-reservation conditions if you are not a Telangana local candidate.
eligibility: 102 zonal-cadre posts of Mandal Planning and Statistical Officer (MPSO) / Assistant Statistical Officer (ASO) in the Directorate of Economics & Statistics, under Notification No. 07/G/ES/2026, dated 28 October 2026. Direct recruitment through a written examination, tentatively in January 2027.
Age 18–44 years as on 1 July 2026 — the upper limit was raised from 34 to 44 by G.O.Ms.No.86 dated 18 May 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST/BC/EWS +5 years, physically handicapped +10 years.

Qualification (must be held by 28 October 2026, the notification date): a Bachelor's degree with Statistics as one of the main subjects; or a Bachelor's degree with Mathematics, Economics, Commerce or Computer Science as a main subject, with Statistics studied as a paper in one, two or all three years. A plain B.Com or B.Sc Maths degree with no Statistics paper in any year does not qualify.

Selection: written examination (qualifying marks 40% for OC, EWS and meritorious sportspersons; 35% for BC; 30% for SC, ST and PH candidates), followed by document verification. The 95% local-reservation rule applies, so check the prescribed local-candidate conditions before applying.

Examination fee ₹80 extra — all unemployed applicants are exempt from the exam fee; government employees (Central/State/PSU/corporation) must pay it. Fees are non-refundable and both must be paid, or the application is rejected outright.

specs: 119 posts: 96 under Direct Recruitment and 23 under Recruitment by Transfer, under the Andhra Pradesh State Judicial (Service & Cadre) Rules, 2026.
Last date extended twice — 26 October, then 10 November, now 30 November 2026 (up to 11:59 PM).

Selection (Direct): Screening Test (computer based, 100 multiple-choice questions, 100 marks, 2 hours; 40% and above shortlists 1:10 for the Written Examination) → Written Examination (Paper I Civil Laws 100, Paper II Criminal Laws 100, Paper III English 100 — translation and essay) → Viva Voce (50 marks, called 1:3).
Screening Test marks are NOT counted in the final merit; Paper I, Paper II and Viva Voce marks decide selection.

Selected candidates are first designated Trainee Judicial Officers: 1 year of training at the Judicial Academy, then 1 year of Law Clerkship, both at half the emoluments of a Civil Judge, before regular appointment.

Typing / shorthand skill certificates, if applicable

donts: Do not apply for a senior post without the prescribed experience — Deputy Director and Accounts Officer need years of experience, not just a degree.
Do not pay the fee by any method other than SBI Collect.
Do not assume the closing date — verify it on the official vacancy portal.
Do not apply for more than one post without checking whether the notice allows it.
dos: Read the official notification on coconutboard.gov.in before choosing a post — qualifications and experience differ sharply by post.
Apply only through the CDB Vacancy page — online only, from 21 November 2026.
Pay the ₹300 fee only through SBI Collect — other payment methods are not accepted.
Confirm the final closing date on the official portal — the notice gives a 30-day window from Employment News publication, and sources differ between 20 and 21 December.
eligibility: Deputy Director (Development): Master's Degree in Horticulture, Agriculture or Plant Sciences with prescribed experience in agricultural or horticultural development (maximum age 40).
Assistant Director (Development): Master's Degree in Horticulture, Agriculture or Plant Sciences with prescribed experience (maximum age 35).
Administrative Officer: Master's Degree with 5 years' prescribed experience in administration and establishment matters (maximum age 30).
Accounts Officer: Associate qualification of ICAI/ICMAI or the prescribed Commerce postgraduate and intermediate professional qualification route, with experience (maximum age 30).

Development Officer: Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture or Horticulture with 2 years' experience (maximum age 30). Development Officer (Technology): B.Tech in Food Processing or Food Technology, or Master's in Food and Nutrition, with 2 years' food-processing experience (maximum age 30).

Assistant: Bachelor's Degree in Arts, Science or Commerce with 3 years' experience in a Government office, autonomous body or statutory organisation (maximum age 30). Auditor: Master's in Commerce or prescribed intermediate professional accountancy qualification with 5 years' relevant experience (maximum age 30).

Junior Translation Officer: Master's Degree in Hindi with English studied as prescribed, with a translation diploma or accepted translation experience (maximum age 30). Stenographer Grade II: Graduation with shorthand 120 wpm and typing 45 wpm (maximum age 30).

Field Officer: Intermediate/Class 12 with Science and a Diploma or Certificate in Agriculture or Horticulture (maximum age 27). Data Entry Operator: Bachelor's Degree with computer data-entry speed of 15,000 key depressions per hour (maximum age 27).
Lower Division Clerk: Class 12 pass with computer typing speed of 35 wpm in English or 30 wpm in Hindi (maximum age 27).

Age is calculated as on the last date for receipt of online applications. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwBD 10 years, Ex-Servicemen and eligible Government servants as per Government of India rules.

eligibility: Dental Surgeon (5): A recognised Bachelor of Dental Surgery degree (under the Dentists Act, 1948) or an equivalent recognised dental qualification; registration with any State Dental Council or Tribunal in India; completion of compulsory rotating internship (candidates who have not yet completed it may still appear, but must complete it before appointment if selected). Maximum age: 35 years (UR), 35 years (EWS), 40 years (SC) as on 4 December 2026.

Ayurveda Physician (2): Degree in Ayurveda of a recognised University / Statutory State Board / Council / Faculty of Indian Systems of Medicine recognised under the Indian Medicine Central Council Act, 1970; enrolment on the Central or State Register for Indian Medicine. Maximum age: 35 years (UR), 35 years (EWS) as on 4 December 2026.

Homeopathic Physician (1): Degree in Homoeopathy of a recognised University / Statutory State Board / Council or equivalent recognised under the Homoeopathic Central Council Act, 1973; enrolment on the Central Register of Homoeopathy or a State Register of Homoeopathy. Maximum age: 35 years (EWS) as on 4 December 2026.

Scientist B (5): Master's Degree in Botany or Horticulture or Chemistry (Organic) from a recognised University or Institute. Maximum age: 35 years (UR), 35 years (EWS), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC) — counted as on 3 July 2026, the original closing date of Advertisement No. 06/2026, not 4 December 2026.
Age is further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD candidates.

specs: 85 पद (अस्थायी) — 35 गैर-शिक्षण designations में, Groups A, B और C में — असिस्टेंट रजिस्ट्रार, सेक्शन ऑफिसर, असिस्टेंट, अपर डिवीजन क्लर्क (UDC), हिंदी/उर्दू टाइपिस्ट, अकाउंटेंट, इलेक्ट्रीशियन, फार्मासिस्ट, प्लंबर, कारपेंटर, बेलदार और अन्य।
Pay Levels 1–13 (₹18,000–₹2,15,900 plus allowances)। सबसे ज़्यादा: UDC 10 पद, बेलदार 6 पद।

Online आवेदन 12 नवंबर–11 दिसंबर 2026 तक jobs.jmi.ac.in पर। Online submit करने के बाद signed hard copy self-attested documents के साथ 21 दिसंबर 2026 तक रजिस्ट्रार कार्यालय भेजें — सिर्फ Speed Post या Courier से (13 नवंबर 2026 का corrigendum: hand delivery accept नहीं होगी)।
हर post के लिए अलग application भरें। Age और qualification 11 दिसंबर 2026 को गिनी जाएगी।

तारांकन (*) वाले 8 पद Advt No. 02/2025-26 (NT) में भी विज्ञापित थे — पहले apply कर चुके उम्मीदवारों को नए सिरे से apply करना है, लेकिन पहले की acknowledgement या postal slip लगाने पर कोई fee नहीं देनी।
पदों की संख्या अस्थायी है — बढ़ या घट सकती है। Notification में category-wise split नहीं दिया गया है।
Notification में कोई common exam pattern या syllabus नहीं दिया गया है — shortlisted candidates को test/interview की date सिर्फ email से बताई जाएगी।

donts: Do not apply for a grade whose experience condition you do not meet — experience is the main filter.
Do not submit one form for two posts — a separate application and fee are needed for each post.
Do not skip the hard copy — online submission alone is not complete.

dos: Read Advt No. RECT-11012/4/2026-RECU SEC fully on aiimsbhubaneswar.nic.in before applying — check the post-wise experience for your grade.
Apply separately for each post, with a separate fee, on aiimsbhubaneswar.nic.in by 13 December 2026.
Send the signed hard copy with self-attested documents by Speed Post or Courier within 7 days of the cut-off date to the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Bhubaneswar, Sijua, Dumuduma, Bhubaneswar-751019.
Keep your MD/MS/DM/M.Ch/Doctorate certificates and experience proofs ready — experience is counted strictly.
eligibility: Professor (28): recognised medical qualification + MD/MS with 14 years' teaching/research experience after MD/MS (12 years after 2/5-year DM/M.Ch; 11 years after 3-year DM/M.Ch); non-medical: Master's + Doctorate with 14 years' experience. Maximum age 58 years.

Additional Professor (12): MD/MS with 10 years' teaching/research experience (superspeciality: 8 years after 2/5-year DM/M.Ch; 7 years after 3-year DM/M.Ch); non-medical: Master's + Doctorate with 10 years' experience. Maximum age 58 years.

Associate Professor (16): MD/MS with 6 years' experience (superspeciality: 4 years after 2/5-year DM/M.Ch; 3 years after 3-year DM/M.Ch); non-medical: Master's + Doctorate with 6 years' experience. Maximum age 50 years.

Assistant Professor (26): MD/MS with 3 years' experience (superspeciality: 1 year after 2/5-year DM/M.Ch; no experience for 3-year DM/M.Ch); non-medical: Master's + Doctorate with 3 years' experience. Maximum age 50 years.
Age is counted as on the last date of online submission (13 December 2026).

en.name: DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
en.qual: Ph.D. / M.Phil. as per UGC norms (discipline-wise)
specs: 219 Assistant Professor posts across 24 disciplines — Computer Science & Engineering 36, Civil Engineering 20, Production Engineering 20, Mechanical Engineering 18, and others (Applied Sciences, Management, Economics, English, Design and allied areas).
The advertisement includes backlog vacancies and a special drive for PwBD candidates (17 PwBD posts identified). Vacancies are provisional and may change as per the University's requirement.
Apply online 23 October 2026 (11 AM)–7 December 2026 (5 PM) at recruitment.dtu.ac.in. The eligibility cut-off date is 7 December 2026.
There is NO upper age limit for Assistant Professor appointments in this advertisement.
Corrigendum dated 2 November 2026 corrected a table reference (5a/5b to 1a/1b) and the title 'Co-Principle Investigator' to 'Co-Principal Investigator' — it does not change the deadline.

The notification does not specify a conventional written examination or a subject-wise written-test syllabus — selection is by screening followed by interview. The pay scale and discipline-wise qualifications are in the University's Recruitment Rules, not printed in the notification.
All facts above are taken from Advertisement No. 04/2026 (No. F.DTU/Rectt./Asst.Prof/2026/F-1018/5602), dated 22 October 2026.

recruitment.dtu.ac.in par registration karen aur apni discipline chunen.
Form bharen aur documents upload karen.
Fee online bharen (₹2,000 UR/OBC; ₹1,000 EWS/SC/ST reserved posts; PwBD nil) — 7 दिसंबर 2026 शाम 5 बजे तक।
Form submit karen aur confirmation save karen. Screening aur interview call ke liye DTU website dekhte rahen.

en.qual: Full-time regular Diploma in Engineering (passed 2022–2026); B.E./B.Tech holders NOT eligible
specs: 500 apprentice slots for 2026–27: Electrical & Electronics Engineering 455, plus Mechanical, Civil, Electronics & Communication and Computer Science/IT (rest). Training is for 1 year, under BOAT-SR (Board of Apprenticeship Training, Southern Region).
THIS IS AN APPRENTICESHIP, NOT A PERMANENT JOB: 1 year of training with a stipend of ₹10,900/month. There is no job guarantee in TNPDCL after the training ends.
Apply 28 October–28 November 2026 through the NATS 2.0 portal (nats.education.gov.in). Candidates must complete NATS enrolment by 20 November 2026.
Only natives of Tamil Nadu can apply.
Selection is on diploma marks only — there is no written examination and no interview.
Age limit: 'as per Apprenticeship Rules' only — no figure is stated in the notification.
All facts above are taken from the TNPDCL Engagement of Apprentices 2026–27 notification, dated 28 October 2026.

en.qual: Bachelor's degree + 2-year D.El.Ed/BTC (Primary); Bachelor's/Master's + B.Ed or equivalent (Junior)
specs: UPTET February 2027 is an eligibility test, not a vacancy recruitment — there is no post count. Passing it makes you eligible to apply for teacher posts in Uttar Pradesh.
Online applications 24 November–23 December 2026 on the UPESSC One Time Registration (OTR) portal, apply.upessc.org. Complete OTR first — without OTR you cannot fill the form.

Exam on 26–27 February 2027 (Primary Level and Junior Level, in Hindi, English, Urdu and Sanskrit mediums). The detailed advertisement (Advt No. 10/2026) is published on upessc.up.gov.in on 24 November 2026.

Primary Level (Classes I–V): Bachelor's degree in any stream with a 2-year D.El.Ed (BTC) / D.Ed / Special D.El.Ed (BTC) / D.El.Ed (Urdu) / B.El.Ed, or Bachelor's degree with a Diploma in Teaching from AMU, Aligarh (final-year appearing candidates also eligible).

Junior Level (Classes VI–VIII): Bachelor's degree with a 2-year D.El.Ed (BTC); or Bachelor's/Master's degree with 50% marks + B.Ed / B.Ed (Special); or 10+2 with 50% marks + 4-year B.El.Ed / B.Sc Ed; or Bachelor's with 45% marks / Master's degree + B.Ed as per NCTE norms (final-year appearing candidates also eligible).
Correction window: till 27 December 2026 (fee ₹200).

en.qual: 10+2 + D.El.Ed (Level I); Bachelor's + B.Ed/D.El.Ed (Level II); Master's + B.Ed (Level III)
specs: HTET December 2026 is an eligibility test, not a vacancy recruitment — there is no post count. Passing it makes you eligible to apply for teacher posts in Haryana.
Apply online 18–27 November 2026 on htet2026.org. Correction window: 28–29 November 2026.
Exam on 26–27 December 2026 (Level I PRT, Level II TGT and Level III PGT).
Level I (PRT, Classes 1–5): 10+2 with 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education / Special Education / B.E.Ed (or 10+2 with 45% marks + the same diploma; or Bachelor's degree + the diploma).

Level II (TGT, Classes 6–8): Bachelor's degree with 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Education / Elementary Education, or Bachelor's with 50% marks + B.Ed / Special B.Ed, or 10+2 with 50% marks + 4-year BA B.Ed / B.Com B.Ed.
Level III (PGT): Master's degree in the concerned subject with 50% marks + B.Ed degree.
Fee depends on how many papers you take — single, double or triple (see fees above). Pay only by online debit card, credit card or net banking.
All facts above are taken from the BSEH detailed notification for HTET December 2026, published 18 November 2026 on htet2026.org.

en.qual: Matriculation (10th pass) + NAC/NTC (ITI) in the relevant trade
specs: 58 posts: Journeyman 55 across 14 trades — Carpenter 2, Crane Operator 2, Diesel Mechanic 2, Driver Material Handling 2, Electrician 8, Electronic Mechanic 6, Fitter 6, GRP/FRP Worker 4, Machine Operator 3, Painter 6, Pipe Fitter 4, Rigger 4, Structural Fitter 4, Welder 2 — plus Driver (Vehicle) 3 (UR 2, OBC 1).

Journeyman: Matriculation (10th pass) + NAC/NTC in the relevant trade. Driver (Vehicle): Matriculation + valid Commercial LMV driving licence + minimum 6 years post-qualification experience of driving Light and Heavy Motor Vehicles (clean driving record, no accidents in the last 6 years).

Age as on 1 October 2026: Journeyman — maximum 26 years; Driver (Vehicle) — maximum 32 years (relaxation for reserved categories, Ex-Servicemen, Ex-Agniveers and internal candidates as per the notification).

Selection: Written Test (100 marks, 2 hours, 100 MCQs — Part I trade-related 80 marks + Part II GK, aptitude, reasoning, numerical ability 20 marks; qualifying 50% overall for Journeyman, 40% for Driver; 45%/35% for SC/ST/OBC, 40%/30% for PwBD) followed by a Practical (Trade) Test (qualifying, 50 marks), then document verification and medical examination. Physical Efficiency Test (qualifying) applies to Driver (Material Handling), Rigger and Crane Operator posts.
Written test at Kolkata & Ranchi, pen-and-paper with OMR sheets, bilingual (English and Hindi).

Higher professional qualifications such as a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Engineering/Technology, MBA, CA, CMA, CS, LL.B, MCA or Ph.D make you NOT eligible for these posts — do not apply with them.
Apply online only — through the Career section of grse.in or jobapply.in/grse2026 — by 28 November 2026 (11:59 PM).
All facts above are taken from Employment Notification No. 2026/05 (J&OP), GRSE Ltd.

specs: 18 posts of Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire), Junior Management Grade Scale-I (JMGS-I), on a regular basis: 17 regular posts (SC 2, ST 1, OBC 1, EWS 1, UR 11 — the vacancy table prints Regular total 17) + 1 ST backlog post. Vacancies are provisional and may vary.
Pay scale ₹48,480–85,920 (JMGS-I) + DA, HRA, CCA, Provident Fund, NPS, LFC, medical facility and other perquisites. Probation: 6 months. Posting: anywhere in India.
Age as on 31 October 2026: minimum 21 years, maximum 40 years (relaxation for reserved categories as per Government of India guidelines).

Eligibility (as on 31 October 2026): B.E. (Fire) from National Fire Service College (NFSC) Nagpur, or B.E./B.Tech (Safety & Fire Engineering), or B.E./B.Tech (Fire Technology & Safety Engineering), or an equivalent 4-year degree in Fire Safety from a UGC-recognised university / AICTE-approved institution — with minimum 2 years composite experience in fire safety in a reputed organisation; OR Graduate Member of the Institution of Fire Engineers (India/UK), or Divisional Officers Course from NFSC Nagpur — with minimum 3 years experience as Station Officer or equivalent in a City/State Fire Brigade, as In-Charge Fire Officer in a corporate/big industrial complex, or as Fire Officer in a State Government institution/PSU.

Selection: online written test (125 questions, 125 marks, 2 hours — English Language 50 marks + Professional Knowledge 75 marks; NO penalty for wrong answers) + interview (100 marks). Merit list on normalised marks — written test 70, interview 30.
Tentative schedule: online examination December 2026 / January 2027; interview January / February 2027; final result February 2027. Call letter by email only.

Apply online 4–25 November 2026 through the link on sbi.bank.in (Careers → Current Openings → Advt CRPD/SCO/2026-27/29). Upload all required documents (resume, ID proof, age proof, caste certificate, experience certificates) — hard copy is NOT to be sent.
All facts above are taken from Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/29, State Bank of India (12-page notification).

en.name: GSPCB Junior Environmental Engineer & Junior Environmental Officer 2026
en.qual: B.E./B.Tech (Civil/Chemical/Mechanical/Environmental) for Junior Environmental Engineer; M.Sc. Environmental Sciences for Junior Environmental Officer; Konkani knowledge + 15-year Goa residence certificate mandatory for both
specs: 11 Group 'B' (Non-Gazetted) posts on regular basis: Junior Environmental Engineer 5 (UR 2, OBC 1, ST 2) and Junior Environmental Officer 6 (UR 5, OBC 1, including 1 PwD). Both posts carry Level 6 of the Pay Matrix.

Online applications 18 November–2 December 2026 on the Goa Centralised Board/Departmental Examination & Selection (CBES) portal, cbes.goa.gov.in. Submit a separate application form for each post if eligible for both.
Maximum age 45 years. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwD 10 years, PwD (SC/ST) 15 years, PwD (OBC) 13 years, Government servants up to 5 years.

Junior Environmental Engineer: Degree in Engineering (Civil/Chemical/Mechanical/Environmental) from a recognised University/Institution. Junior Environmental Officer: Master's Degree in Environmental Sciences. Both posts: knowledge of Konkani is essential and a 15-year Goa residence certificate is mandatory; knowledge of Marathi is desirable. All certificates must be valid on the last date of application; Government servants must have an NOC from the employer.

Selection: one written examination of 75 marks (MCQ, 90 minutes) — Konkani 10 marks (first 10 questions; at least 4 marks needed to be evaluated further), post subject 30 marks, General Knowledge/reasoning/ability 35 marks — followed by verification of documents. Selection is strictly on written-exam marks; no marks for educational qualifications. Minimum passing marks: Unreserved 45%, OBC 40%, ST/PwD 35%.

Written examination date will be intimated by press note, on goaspcb.gov.in and in a local daily. Syllabus and scheme of examination will be uploaded shortly on goaspcb.gov.in and goa.gov.in. Waiting list is valid up to one year from the date of its preparation.
All facts above are taken from GSPCB Advertisement No. 02/2026 (No. 1/5/26/PCB/Vol.36/Part/Admin/20609), dated 13 November 2026 (goaspcb.gov.in).

specs: 8 Assistant Director posts in A.P. State Forensic Science Service (state-wide post): Forensic Engineering 1, Physics 2, Chemistry 2, Biology 3 (including 1 carried-forward vacancy). Pay scale ₹57,100–1,47,760.
Online applications 19 November–13 December 2026 (up to 11:59 PM) only on psc.ap.gov.in, through One Time Profile Registration (OTPR).

Age 18–44 years as on 1 July 2026. Relaxation: SC, ST, BC and EWS 5 years; Ex-Servicemen and NCC Instructors get service-period deductions; regular A.P. State Government employees get service deduction up to 5 years.

Qualification and experience are counted as on the date of the notification, 19 November 2026. Forensic Engineering needs B.E. in Mechanical or Structural Engineering; Physics needs M.Sc. 1st/2nd class in Physics; Chemistry needs M.Sc. 1st/2nd class in Chemistry or B.Sc. with A.I.C. in Forensic Science; Biology needs M.Sc. 1st/2nd class in Botany/Ecology/Microbiology/Biochemistry or a Degree in Medicine with B.Sc. (Chemistry, Botany, Zoology, Physics).
All four posts need at least 5 years practical experience in a Forensic Science, Chemical, Analytical or Police Laboratory, and exceptionally good eye-sight — colour blindness is a disqualification.

Selection: online Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) — Paper I General Studies and Mental Ability (150 questions, 150 marks, 150 minutes) + Paper II subject paper (150 questions, 300 marks, 150 minutes); 1/3rd negative marking for wrong answers. Shortlisted candidates must then qualify the Computer Proficiency Test (CPT). Minimum qualifying marks: OC & EWS 40%, Backward Classes 35%, SC/ST 30%.

Written exam (CBRT) date will be intimated later. Exam centres: Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Tirupati and Ananthapuramu (choose 3 preferences). Paper I is in English and Telugu (English is authentic); subject papers are in English only. A General Mock Test is available on the Commission's website.
Correction window: corrections open after the last date of applications and are allowed for up to 7 days (fee ₹100 per correction). Name, fee and age-relaxation fields cannot be corrected.

specs: A.P. State Forensic Science Service में 8 असिस्टेंट डायरेक्टर पद (state-wide post): फॉरेंसिक इंजीनियरिंग 1, फिजिक्स 2, केमिस्ट्री 2, बायोलॉजी 3 (1 carried-forward vacancy सहित)। Pay scale ₹57,100–1,47,760।
Online आवेदन 19 नवंबर–13 दिसंबर 2026 (रात 11:59 बजे तक), सिर्फ psc.ap.gov.in पर, One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) के ज़रिए।
आयु 18–44 वर्ष (1 जुलाई 2026 को)। छूट: SC, ST, BC और EWS को 5 साल; भूतपूर्व सैनिक और NCC Instructor को service-period deduction; नियमित A.P. राज्य सरकार कर्मचारियों को 5 साल तक service deduction।

योग्यता और अनुभव notification की तारीख, 19 नवंबर 2026 को गिने जाते हैं। फॉरेंसिक इंजीनियरिंग के लिए B.E. (मैकेनिकल या स्ट्रक्चरल); फिजिक्स के लिए M.Sc. प्रथम/द्वितीय श्रेणी; केमिस्ट्री के लिए M.Sc. प्रथम/द्वितीय श्रेणी या B.Sc. + A.I.C. (फॉरेंसिक साइंस); बायोलॉजी के लिए M.Sc. प्रथम/द्वितीय श्रेणी (बॉटनी/इकोलॉजी/माइक्रोबायोलॉजी/बायोकेमिस्ट्री) या मेडिसिन में डिग्री + B.Sc. (केमिस्ट्री, बॉटनी, ज़ूलॉजी, फिजिक्स)।
सभी चार पदों के लिए फॉरेंसिक साइंस, केमिकल, एनालिटिकल या पुलिस लैबोरेटरी में कम से कम 5 साल का practical अनुभव ज़रूरी है, और exceptionally good eye-sight चाहिए — colour blindness अयोग्यता है।

चयन: online Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) — Paper I General Studies & Mental Ability (150 प्रश्न, 150 अंक, 150 मिनट) + Paper II विषय पेपर (150 प्रश्न, 300 अंक, 150 मिनट); गलत उत्तर पर 1/3rd negative marking। Shortlisted उम्मीदवारों को Computer Proficiency Test (CPT) qualify करना होगा। न्यूनतम qualifying marks: OC & EWS 40%, Backward Classes 35%, SC/ST 30%。

लिखित परीक्षा (CBRT) की तारीख बाद में बताई जाएगी। परीक्षा केंद्र: विशाखापत्तनम, विजयवाड़ा, तिरुपति और अनंतपुरमु (3 preferences चुनें)। Paper I अंग्रेज़ी और तेलुगु में (अंग्रेज़ी authentic); विषय पेपर सिर्फ अंग्रेज़ी में। Commission की website पर General Mock Test उपलब्ध है।
Correction window: last date के बाद 7 दिन तक सुधार कर सकते हैं (fee ₹100 प्रति correction)। नाम, fee और age-relaxation वाले fields नहीं बदले जा सकते।
ऊपर के सभी तथ्य APPSC Notification No. 38/2026, दिनांक 19 नवंबर 2026 (psc.ap.gov.in) से लिए गए हैं।

Walk-in interviews 23–28 November 2026 at Goa SRLM, 7th Floor, Spaces Building, Patto, Panaji: 23 Nov — District Manager (Knowledge Management & Communication), Block Manager (Institution Building & Capacity Building), Block Manager (VA/ML/CD); 24 Nov — Block Manager (MIS), Block Manager (Financial Inclusion); 25 Nov — Block Manager (Social Inclusion & Social Development), Block Manager (Farm Livelihood), Block Manager (Non Farm Livelihood); 26 Nov — Mission Executive (Non Farm Livelihood), Mission Executive (Financial Management), Block Project Manager (SVEP); 28 Nov — Personal Secretary (CEO & COO), Office Assistant. Agriculture / Horticulture or Food Technology, as per domain — + 2 years (PG) / 3 years (Graduate) experience; Mission Executives — PG Degree/Diploma in Commerce / Food Technology / MBA or Financial Management / Accounting / Banking + 3 years experience; Block Project Manager (SVEP) — Graduate (Maths till Class XII), PG Degree/Diploma in Management/Commerce/Engineering preferred + 2 years experience; Personal Secretary — H.S.S.C. + Computer Application Diploma or short-term course; Office Assistant — H.S.S.C. pass; Cluster Coordinator — H.S.S.C. + at least 2 years community-level experience as Community Cadre, SHG member and preferably from the same CLF.

Submit a separate application form for each post; write 'National Rural Livelihood Mission – NRLM' at the top of the form. en.qual: Graduate in any stream (B.E., B.Com., B.A., B.Sc., BCA etc.) from a recognised University/Institute as prescribed by AICTE or UGC
specs: 48 Graduate Apprentice seats for 2026-27, 12 months' training at the Apprentices Training Centre (ATC), Mechanical & Electrical Engineering Department, Mumbai Port Authority. Total stipend ₹12,300 per month — Establishment share ₹6,150 + Government share ₹6,150, paid through DBT.

The notification does not specify an application start date — the advertisement is live on mumbaiport.gov.in. The filled form, with documents and the fee (UTR) receipt, must reach the ATC by 18 December 2026, 5:00 PM, by hand or by post. Late or incomplete applications are rejected.
Age 18–25 years as on 1 November 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, Divyang/PwD 10 years, as per Government rules (certificate required).

Selection: merit list on the basis of percentage of total marks in the Degree Examination. Tie: the older candidate ranks above. Preference is given to wards of Mumbai Port Authority employees, with separate merit lists for wards and other candidates. The list is displayed on the ATC notice board and on the website; listed candidates are called for verification of original documents at the ATC.
Selected candidates undergo a medical examination and must produce a fitness certificate from the Port Authority Hospital. Final selection is subject to BOAT registration.

This is a 12-month apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961 — NOT a permanent job. There is no obligation of employment after training. Candidates who have already undergone, or are undergoing, apprenticeship in the same trade under the Apprentices Act, 1961 are not eligible. Leaving the training midway makes the apprentice liable for the cost of training, up to a maximum of 3 months' stipend.

CGPA/grade-point conversion formula must be produced. Caste certificate must be produced in original at document verification. No TA/DA is paid for document verification or the medical examination. Help desk: 022-66566637 / 66566625, 10 AM–5 PM, except Saturdays, Sundays and holidays.

hi.name: मुंबई पोर्ट अथॉरिटी ग्रेजुएट अप्रेंटिस 2026
hi.qual: किसी भी stream में Graduate (B.E., B.Com., B.A., B.Sc., BCA आदि) — AICTE/UGC के अनुसार मान्यता प्राप्त University/Institute से
specs: 2026-27 के लिए 48 ग्रेजुएट अप्रेंटिस सीटें, 12 महीने की training — Apprentices Training Centre (ATC), Mechanical & Electrical Engineering Department, Mumbai Port Authority। कुल stipend ₹12,300 प्रति माह — Establishment share ₹6,150 + Government share ₹6,150, DBT से भुगतान।

Notification में application की start date नहीं लिखी है — advertisement mumbaiport.gov.in पर live है। भरा हुआ form, documents और fee (UTR) receipt के साथ, 18 दिसंबर 2026, शाम 5 बजे तक ATC तक by hand या by post पहुंचना चाहिए। देर से या अधूरे application reject कर दिए जाते हैं।

en.name: Mumbai Port Authority COPA Trade Apprentice 2026
en.qual: 10th pass (10+2) + COPA Trade Certificate issued by NCVT
specs: 96 COPA (Computer Operator and Programming Assistant) Trade Apprentice seats for 2026-27, 12 months' training at the Apprentices Training Centre (ATC), Mechanical & Electrical Engineering Department, Mumbai Port Authority. Stipend ₹10,560 per month.

The notification does not specify an application start date — the advertisement is live on mumbaiport.gov.in. The filled form, with documents and the fee (UTR) receipt, must reach the ATC by 18 December 2026, 5:00 PM, by hand or by post. Late or incomplete applications are rejected.
Age 18–25 years as on 1 November 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, Divyang/PWD 10 years, as per Government rules (certificate required).

Selection: merit list on the basis of percentage of total marks in BOTH semesters of the COPA ITI Trade Examination. Candidates with a higher qualification get preference, in descending order: Post Graduate, Graduate, 3-year Diploma, 12th pass. Tie: the older candidate ranks above. Preference is given to wards of Mumbai Port Authority employees, with separate merit lists for wards and other candidates.

Listed candidates are called for verification of original documents at the ATC, then a medical examination, and must produce a fitness certificate from the Port Authority Hospital. Final selection is subject to RDAT/NCVT registration.

This is a 12-month apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961 — NOT a permanent job. There is no obligation of employment after training. Candidates who have already undergone, or are undergoing, apprenticeship in the same trade under the Apprentices Act, 1961 are not eligible. Leaving the training midway makes the apprentice liable for the cost of training, up to a maximum of 3 months' stipend.
CGPA conversion formula must be produced. Caste certificate must be produced in original at document verification. No TA/DA is paid for document verification or the medical examination.
All facts above are taken from the Mumbai Port Authority COPA Trade Apprentice 2026-27 notification (mumbaiport.gov.in).

specs: 108 posts under the National Health Mission, District Health & Family Welfare Samity, Purulia — Medical Officer AYUSH (MHT) Male 36 (ST 2, SC 9, OBC 3, EWS 4, UR PwBD 1, UR 17), Medical Officer AYUSH (MHT) Female 32 (ST 2, SC 8, OBC 3, EWS 3, UR PwBD 1, UR 15), Pharmacist RBSK 38 (ST 2, SC 9, OBC 3, EWS 4, UR PwBD 1, UR 19), Staff Nurse RBSK 2 (SC 1, UR 1). Consolidated remuneration: Medical Officer ₹32,000/month, Pharmacist ₹22,000/month, Staff Nurse ₹25,000/month.
All posts are purely contractual and temporary under the National Health Mission — selected candidates have no claim to permanent appointment. See the note above.

Online applications 19 November 2026 (10:00 AM)–3 December 2026, only through wbhealth.gov.in (Quick links → Career, Education & Recruitment → Online Recruitment). Last date of online registration: 2 December 2026. Apply for more than one post if eligible, but only one application per post — more than one application for the same post cancels all of them.
Age: maximum 40 years as on 1 April 2026 for all four posts (Pharmacist: minimum 18, maximum 40 years). Age relaxation for reserved categories as per Government of West Bengal rules.

Qualification: Medical Officer AYUSH — BHMS/BAMS/BUMS from an institution recognised by the respective Council, compulsory internship completed, Registration Certificate of the respective Council (BHMS must be in the Second Schedule of the Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973; registered in Part-A, State Register of Homoeopathic Medical Practitioners, West Bengal, or Part I, Central Register). Desirable: MD in Homoeopathy/Ayurvedic/Unani. Pharmacist RBSK — 2-year Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharma, Allopathic) from a PCI/AICTE-approved institute + registration certificate from the West Bengal Pharmacy Council; B-Pharma/M-Pharma holders get additional marks. Staff Nurse RBSK — GNM training from an Indian Nursing Council-recognised institute + registration certificate from the West Bengal Nursing Council; clinical experience in a Government/Private hospital is desirable. All posts: permanent resident of West Bengal, able to read, write and speak Bengali.

Selection (total 100 marks, proportionate marking) by the District Level Selection Committee, Purulia: Medical Officer — Class 10 max 20, Class 12 max 20, BHMS/BAMS/BUMS max 40, MD (Homoeopathy/Ayurvedic/Unani) 20 additional marks. Pharmacist — Class 10 max 20, Class 12 max 20, Diploma in Pharmacy max 30, B-Pharma 20 additional, M-Pharma 10 additional. Staff Nurse — Class 10 max 30, Class 12 max 30, GNM max 20, clinical experience max 20 (1–2 years: 5; 2–3 years: 10; 3–4 years: 15; 4+ years: 20). Inclusion in the Computer Test/Interview/Document Verification list does not confer appointment. No separate exam syllabus is given in the notification.

No physical documents need to be sent to the office. At document verification, carry originals of all testimonials and documents supporting every claim, and submit one set of self-attested copies. Experience certificates must state the duration, post, nature of work and the employer's signature with date, with salary slips for the last three months for each claimed period. DGPA/CGPA conversion formula must be attached. Failure to produce originals may result in cancellation.

Posting may be anywhere under the District AYUSH Samity / DH&FWS, Purulia. The Samity reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason. Prescribed conditions are non-relaxable. Omission or suppression of information results in rejection at any stage.

Both posts are purely contractual and temporary under the National Health Mission — selected candidates have no claim to permanent appointment. See the note above.

Online applications 19 November 2026 (10:00 AM)–3 December 2026, only through wbhealth.gov.in (Quick links → Career, Education & Recruitment → Online Recruitment). Last date of online registration: 2 December 2026. One application per post — more than one application for the same post cancels all of them.

Age: Staff Nurse (NUHM) — maximum 40 years as on 1 April 2026. Pharmacist (NUHM) — minimum 18, maximum 40 years as on 1 April 2026. Age relaxation for reserved categories as per Government of West Bengal rules.

Qualification: Staff Nurse (NUHM) — completed GNM course from an Indian Nursing Council-recognised institute OR completed B.Sc. Nursing course; registered under the West Bengal Nursing Council; proficiency in the local language. Desirable: experience working in a hospital setting. Pharmacist (NUHM) — permanent resident of West Bengal; 2-year Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharma, Allopathic) recognised by the Government of West Bengal, registered as 'A' category Pharmacist under the West Bengal Pharmacy Council; efficiency in computers including MS Office and internet. Weightage for higher qualification (B-Pharma/M-Pharma).

en.qual: Matriculation + 2-year ITI Draughtsman (Civil / Architecture) course + minimum 3 years post-qualification experience (2 years in bridge/railway alignment drawings for RG/51/26; 2 years in railway station architectural drawings for RG/52/26); AutoCAD proficiency; full-time Diploma in Civil/Architecture also eligible
specs: 5 Technician-I (Draughtsman) posts on regular basis: RG/51/26 — Technician-I (Draughtsman / Bridges & Railway alignment), Civil, 4 posts (UR 2, EWS 1, ST 1); RG/52/26 — Technician-I (Draughtsman / Stations), Architecture, 1 post (UR 1). Pay ₹22,000–83,000, fixed at the minimum of the scale. Probation 1 year; liable to be posted anywhere in India or abroad.

Online applications 16 November–15 December 2026 on recruit.rites.com. Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are reckoned as on 15 December 2026. One application for one vacancy — apply separately, with a separate fee, for each post code. Hard copies are NOT to be sent by post/courier.

Age: 33 years for both RG/51/26 and RG/52/26. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years, J&K Domicile 5 years, PwBD 10 years (in addition to category relaxation), RITES regular/contract employees 5 years. Identified PwBD categories: Locomotor disability, Hearing Impairment.

Qualification and experience: RG/51/26 — Matriculation plus 2-year ITI Draughtsman Civil course; minimum 3 years post-qualification experience, of which minimum 2 years in preparation of Bridge Drawings and railway alignment drawings and related structures; proficient in AutoCAD. RG/52/26 — Matriculation plus 2-year ITI Draughtsman Architecture/Civil course; minimum 3 years post-qualification experience, of which minimum 2 years in preparation of architectural drawings for railway stations, station buildings/depots; proficient in AutoCAD and conversant with general arrangement drawings (GADs), floor plans, elevations, sections, architectural detailing and quantity-related drawings.

Full-time Diploma in Civil (for RG/51/26) or in Architecture/Civil (for RG/52/26) holders are also eligible at the same pay scale, but other higher qualifications are NOT considered for eligibility. Minimum marks in the essential qualification: 50% for UR/EWS (and reserved-category candidates applying against unreserved posts); 45% for reserved-category candidates against reserved posts.

Selection: (1) Written Test — 125 objective questions, 1 mark each, 2.5 hours, NO negative marking; PwBD candidates get 50 minutes compensatory time; minimum 50% marks for UR/EWS (45% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts) to be considered. (2) Document Scrutiny — qualifying candidates only, initially in a ratio of 1:3 of the vacancies; offers in order of merit only to the extent of vacancies. Test centres (two preferences): Delhi/Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Mumbai, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar — all except Delhi/Gurgaon are tentative.

RG/50/26 Technical Assistant (Draughtsman / Bridges & Railway alignment), Civil, 3 posts, is a DIFFERENT post advertised in the same combined notice — it is not included in these 5 Technician-I posts.

Allowances include Basic + DA, Performance Related Pay, Medical, HRA, superannuation benefits (PF, Gratuity, Post Retirement Medical Scheme), leaves, maternity/paternity leave, medical and group insurance, leave encashment. OBC-NCL certificate must not be older than 1 year on the crucial date (15 December 2026) and must carry the Annexure III declaration; EWS certificate must be valid for FY 2026-27. Queries only to rectt@rites.com with VC No., Registration/Roll No., full name and the email given in the application.
All facts above are taken from the RITES combined notice for Vc. Nos. RG/50/26 to RG/52/26, hosted 16 November 2026 (rites.com).

hi.name: राइट्स टेक्नीशियन-I (ड्राफ्ट्समैन) 2026
hi.qual: Matriculation + 2 साल का ITI ड्राफ्ट्समैन (सिविल / आर्किटेक्चर) कोर्स + न्यूनतम 3 साल का post-qualification अनुभव (RG/51/26 के लिए bridge/railway alignment drawings में 2 साल; RG/52/26 के लिए railway station architectural drawings में 2 साल); AutoCAD में दक्षता; सिविल/आर्किटेक्चर में full-time Diploma भी पात्र
specs: Regular basis पर 5 टेक्नीशियन-I (ड्राफ्ट्समैन) पद: RG/51/26 — टेक्नीशियन-I (ड्राफ्ट्समैन / Bridges & Railway alignment), सिविल, 4 पद (UR 2, EWS 1, ST 1); RG/52/26 — टेक्नीशियन-I (ड्राफ्ट्समैन / Stations), आर्किटेक्चर, 1 पद (UR 1)। Pay ₹22,000–83,000, scale के minimum पर fixed। Probation 1 साल; भारत या विदेश में कहीं भी posting हो सकती है।

Online आवेदन 16 नवंबर–15 दिसंबर 2026, recruit.rites.com पर। Age, experience और सभी eligibility criteria 15 दिसंबर 2026 को गिने जाते हैं। एक vacancy के लिए एक application — हर post code के लिए अलग से, अलग fee के साथ apply करें। Hard copies डाक/courier से न भेजें।

आयु: RG/51/26 और RG/52/26 दोनों के लिए 33 वर्ष। छूट: SC/ST 5 साल, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 साल, J&K Domicile 5 साल, PwBD 10 साल (category relaxation के अलावा), RITES regular/contract कर्मचारी 5 साल। PwBD categories: Locomotor disability, Hearing Impairment।

योग्यता और अनुभव: RG/51/26 — Matriculation + 2 साल का ITI ड्राफ्ट्समैन सिविल कोर्स; न्यूनतम 3 साल का post-qualification अनुभव, जिनमें न्यूनतम 2 साल Bridge Drawings और railway alignment drawings और संबंधित structures तैयार करने का; AutoCAD में proficient। RG/52/26 — Matriculation + 2 साल का ITI ड्राफ्ट्समैन आर्किटेक्चर/सिविल कोर्स; न्यूनतम 3 साल का post-qualification अनुभव, जिनमें न्यूनतम 2 साल railway stations, station buildings/depots के architectural drawings तैयार करने का; AutoCAD में proficient और general arrangement drawings (GADs), floor plans, elevations, sections, architectural detailing और quantity-related drawings से परिचित।

सिविल में full-time Diploma (RG/51/26 के लिए) या आर्किटेक्चर/सिविल में full-time Diploma (RG/52/26 के लिए) वाले भी उसी pay scale पर पात्र हैं, लेकिन अन्य higher qualifications eligibility के लिए नहीं मानी जाएंगी। Essential qualification में न्यूनतम अंक: UR/EWS के लिए 50% (और unreserved पदों के लिए apply करने वाले आरक्षित श्रेणी के उम्मीदवारों के लिए भी); आरक्षित पदों के लिए आरक्षित श्रेणी के उम्मीदवारों के लिए 45%।

चयन: (1) Written Test — 125 objective प्रश्न, हर एक 1 अंक, 2.5 घंटे, कोई negative marking नहीं; PwBD उम्मीदवारों को 50 मिनट का compensatory time; विचार के लिए UR/EWS को न्यूनतम 50% अंक (आरक्षित पदों पर SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD को 45%)। (2) Document Scrutiny — सिर्फ qualifying उम्मीदवारों की, शुरुआत में vacancies के 1:3 ratio में; offers सिर्फ merit के order में, vacancies की सीमा तक। Test centres (दो preferences): Delhi/Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Mumbai, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar — Delhi/Gurgaon के अलावा सभी tentative हैं।
RG/50/26 Technical Assistant (Draughtsman / Bridges & Railway alignment), सिविल, 3 पद, उसी combined notice में advertise किया गया एक अलग पद है — यह इन 5 Technician-I पदों में शामिल नहीं है।

Allowances में Basic + DA, Performance Related Pay, Medical, HRA, superannuation benefits (PF, Gratuity, Post Retirement Medical Scheme), leaves, maternity/paternity leave, medical और group insurance, leave encashment शामिल हैं। OBC-NCL certificate crucial date (15 दिसंबर 2026) को 1 साल से पुराना नहीं होना चाहिए और उसमें Annexure III declaration होना चाहिए; EWS certificate FY 2026-27 के लिए valid होना चाहिए। Queries सिर्फ rectt@rites.com पर, VC No., Registration/Roll No., पूरा नाम और application में दिया गया email लिखकर।
ऊपर के सभी तथ्य RITES के Vc. Nos. RG/50/26 to RG/52/26 के combined notice, hosted 16 नवंबर 2026 (rites.com) से लिए गए हैं।

specs: 3 Technical Assistant (Draughtsman / Bridges & Railway alignment) posts, Civil discipline — all UR (UR 3; EWS, OBC (NCL), SC, ST nil). Pay ₹24,000–90,000, on regular basis.

Online applications 16 November–15 December 2026 on recruit.rites.com. Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are reckoned as on 15 December 2026. One application for one vacancy — apply separately, with a separate fee, for each post code. Hard copies are NOT to be sent by post/courier.

Age: 36 years as on 15 December 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years, J&K Domicile 5 years, PwBD 10 years (in addition to category relaxation, where the post is identified suitable for PwBD — Locomotor disability and Hearing Impairment for Civil/Architecture), RITES regular/contract employees 5 years. The notice states no specific number of years for Ex-Servicemen.

Qualification and experience: Matriculation + 2-year ITI Draughtsman (Civil) course; minimum 6 years post-qualification experience, of which minimum 5 years in preparation of Bridge Drawings and railway alignment drawings and related structures; the candidate should be proficient in AutoCAD.

Selection: Written Test — 125 objective questions, 1 mark each, 2.5 hours, NO negative marking; PwBD candidates get 50 minutes compensatory time. Qualifying marks: UR/EWS 50%, SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD 45% (against reserved posts). Then Document Scrutiny of written-test qualifiers, initially in the ratio 1:3 of the vacancies notified; offers in order of merit, only to the extent of vacancies notified. Tie of marks: the older candidate is placed above the younger. Candidates may appear in Hindi or English. No interview stage is described for these posts in the notice.

Written Test centres (6): Delhi/Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Mumbai, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar — give two centre preferences at application; RITES may allot a centre not preferred. All centres except Delhi/Gurgaon are tentative, depending on the number of candidates and RITES' discretion. Exact date, time and venue are communicated separately.
RG/51/26 and RG/52/26 Technician-I (Draughtsman) posts (5 posts) are separate vacancies under the same combined notice — this entry covers only RG/50/26 Technical Assistant (3 posts).
All facts above are taken from the RITES recruitment notice Vc. Nos. RG/50/26 to RG/52/26 (rites.com).

en.name: UPPSC Civil Judge (Junior Division) PCS Exam 2026
en.qual: Bachelor of Laws from a University established by law in Uttar Pradesh or another University in India recognised by the Governor; enrolled as an advocate under the Advocates Act, 1961, entitled to practise in courts subordinate to the High Court; at least one year of legal practice as on the date of publication of the advertisement (or other prescribed experience)
specs: 365 Civil Judge (Junior Division) posts in the U.P. Judicial Service: Unreserved 148, SC 76, ST 07, OBC 98, EWS 36. Horizontal reservation: Women 71, Ex-Servicemen 15, PwBD 12, Dependents of Freedom Fighters 04. Pay Level-10, ₹77,840–1,36,520.
Online applications 20 November–21 December 2026 on uppsc.up.nic.in. Last date for fee deposition 21 December 2026; last date for correction/modification and fee reconciliation 28 December 2026.

OTR is MANDATORY: complete your One Time Registration at otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before submitting the application; the form is submitted through the OTR-based 'Online Application Form Submission' page on uppsc.up.nic.in (open the advertisement on the Notifications page and click Apply).

Age: attained 22 years and not attained 35 years on 01.07.2027 (born after 01/07/2005 and not before 02/07/1992). Relaxation: +5 years SC/ST, OBC and skilled players of U.P.; +3 years for army service (Emergency/Short Service Commissioned Officers, ex-Army personnel of U.P.); PwBD as per G.O. dated 03.02.2008 (not born before 02.07.1977). Candidates eligible in age for the 2023, 2024 and 2025 examinations are deemed eligible (not born before 02/07/1989). Maximum 4 chances. The increase of the upper age limit from 35 to 40 years under the U.P. Recruitment to Service (Age Limit) (Tenth Amendment) Rules, 2012 was NOT adopted for this service.

Qualification (transitional, per Supreme Court judgment dated 21.08.2026 in Bhumika Trust vs Union of India): Indian national; Bachelor of Laws from a University established by law in Uttar Pradesh or another University in India recognised by the Governor; advocate enrolled under the Advocates Act, 1961, entitled to practise in courts subordinate to the High Court; at least one year of legal practice as on the date of publication of the advertisement (or other prescribed experience).

Selection — three stages: (1) Preliminary Examination (objective): Paper-I General Knowledge, 2 hours, 150 marks; Paper-II Law, 2 hours, 300 marks; negative marking of one-third (0.33) of the marks for each wrong answer. (2) Main (Written) Examination, 6 papers of 3 hours each, total 1000 marks: General Knowledge 200; English Language 100 (Essay 50, Precis 30, Hindi-to-English translation 20); Hindi Language 100 (Essay 50, Precis 30, English-to-Hindi translation 20); Law-I (Substantive Law) 200; Law-II (Procedure and Evidence) 200; Law-III (Penal, Revenue and Local Laws) 200. (3) Interview (Viva-voce) 100 marks, added to written marks for merit. Admission ratio 1:10 for Main and 1:3 for interview. Preliminary examination at centres in districts of U.P.

Minimum efficiency standard in the Preliminary Examination: 35% for SC/ST candidates and 35% for PwBD candidates (a 40% threshold is also stated in the same instructions for placement in the merit/select list).
All facts above are taken from the UPPSC Civil Judge (Junior Division) Examination 2026 notification, Advt. No. A-6/E-1/2026 (uppsc.up.nic.in).

hi.name: UPPSC सिविल जज (जूनियर डिवीजन) PCS परीक्षा 2026
hi.qual: उत्तर प्रदेश में law से स्थापित University या Governor से recognised भारत की किसी अन्य University से Bachelor of Laws; Advocates Act, 1961 के तहत advocate के रूप में enrolled, High Court के अधीनस्थ न्यायालयों में practice का हकदार; advertisement की date तक कम से कम एक साल की legal practice (या अन्य prescribed अनुभव)
specs: U.P. Judicial Service में 365 सिविल जज (जूनियर डिवीजन) पद: Unreserved 148, SC 76, ST 07, OBC 98, EWS 36। Horizontal reservation: Women 71, Ex-Servicemen 15, PwBD 12, Dependents of Freedom Fighters 04। Pay Level-10, ₹77,840–1,36,520।
Online आवेदन 20 नवंबर–21 दिसंबर 2026 तक uppsc.up.nic.in पर। Fee deposition की last date 21 दिसंबर 2026; correction/modification और fee reconciliation की last date 28 दिसंबर 2026।

OTR अनिवार्य है: आवेदन submit करने से कम से कम 72 घंटे पहले otr.pariksha.nic.in पर One Time Registration पूरा करें; form uppsc.up.nic.in पर OTR-based 'Online Application Form Submission' page से भरा जाता है (Notifications page पर advertisement खोलकर 'Apply' पर click करें)।

आयु: 01.07.2027 को 22 वर्ष पूरे और 35 वर्ष पूरे नहीं (01/07/2005 के बाद और 02/07/1992 से पहले जन्म नहीं)। छूट: SC/ST, OBC और U.P. के skilled players को +5 साल; army service (Emergency/Short Service Commissioned Officers, U.P. के ex-Army personnel) को +3 साल; PwBD G.O. दिनांक 03.02.2008 के अनुसार (02.07.1977 से पहले जन्म नहीं)। 2023, 2024 और 2025 की परीक्षाओं के लिए आयु में पात्र उम्मीदवार पात्र माने जाएंगे (02/07/1989 से पहले जन्म नहीं)। अधिकतम 4 chances। U.P. Recruitment to Service (Age Limit) (Tenth Amendment) Rules, 2012 के तहत upper age limit 35 से 40 साल बढ़ाने का नियम इस service के लिए लागू नहीं हुआ है।

योग्यता (Supreme Court के 21.08.2026 के Bhumika Trust vs Union of India judgment के अनुसार transitional rule): भारतीय नागरिक; उत्तर प्रदेश में law से स्थापित University या Governor से recognised भारत की किसी अन्य University से Bachelor of Laws; Advocates Act, 1961 के तहत enrolled advocate, High Court के अधीनस्थ न्यायालयों में practice का हकदार; advertisement की date तक कम से कम एक साल की legal practice (या अन्य prescribed अनुभव)।

चयन — तीन stages: (1) Preliminary Examination (objective): Paper-I General Knowledge, 2 घंटे, 150 marks; Paper-II Law, 2 घंटे, 300 marks; हर गलत उत्तर पर 1/3 (0.33) negative marking। (2) Main (Written) Examination, 6 papers, 3 घंटे प्रत्येक, कुल 1000 marks: General Knowledge 200; English Language 100 (Essay 50, Precis 30, Hindi-to-English translation 20); Hindi Language 100 (Essay 50, Precis 30, English-to-Hindi translation 20); Law-I (Substantive Law) 200; Law-II (Procedure and Evidence) 200; Law-III (Penal, Revenue and Local Laws) 200। (3) Interview (Viva-voce) 100 marks, merit के लिए written marks में जुड़ते हैं। Main के लिए 1:10 और interview के लिए 1:3 का ratio। Preliminary examination U.P. के जिलों के केंद्रों पर।

Preliminary Examination में minimum efficiency standard: SC/ST उम्मीदवारों के लिए 35% और PwBD उम्मीदवारों के लिए 35% (merit/select list में स्थान के लिए उन्हीं instructions में 40% का threshold भी लिखा है)।
ऊपर के सभी तथ्य UPPSC Civil Judge (Junior Division) Examination 2026 notification, Advt. No. A-6/E-1/2026 (uppsc.up.nic.in) से लिए गए हैं।

'Authenticate with OTR Server' se OTR verify करें aur form भरें (Advt. No. A-6/E-1/2026, Civil Judge (Junior Division) Examination 2026)।
SBI MOPS se Preliminary examination fee भरें (UR/EWS/OBC ₹125; SC/ST ₹65; PwD ₹25) — 21 दिसंबर 2026 तक।
Form submit karke receipt save करें; correction/modification 28 दिसंबर 2026 तक खुला है।

Medical registration certificate
Teaching/research experience certificates (counted as on 31.12.2026)

Recent passport-size photo

donts: Do not apply with one form for two posts — a separate application and fee is needed for each post.
Do not miss the hard-copy deadline (10 January 2027) — the online form alone is not enough.
Do not apply if you do not meet the post-wise teaching/research experience counted as on 31.12.2026.
Do not wait for the last day — the portal closes on 31 December 2026.
dos: Read the AIIMS Mangalagiri faculty advertisement (Advt. No. /03/Faculty/2026/03) fully on aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in before applying.
Apply only on the AIIMS Mangalagiri exams portal — aiimsmgexams.netlify.app/faculty > 'Go to Applications' (candidate login/registration page).
Register/sign in on the portal first, then fill a separate application (and fee) for each post you apply for.
Pay the fee online (UR/EWS/OBC ₹3,100; SC/ST/Women ₹2,100; PwBD ₹100) before 31 December 2026.
Send the hard copy of the application so that it reaches AIIMS Mangalagiri by 10 January 2027.
eligibility: Medical candidates: a medical qualification in the I/II schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956, plus MD/MS in the respective discipline (M.Ch. for surgical superspecialities, D.M. for medical superspecialities).
Non-medical candidates: postgraduate qualification (master's degree) in the discipline/allied subject plus a doctorate.

Teaching/research experience after the qualifying degree: Professor 14 years, Additional Professor 10 years, Associate Professor 6 years, Assistant Professor 3 years (shorter for D.M./M.Ch. holders; non-medical experience counted after the doctorate on the same scale).
Age (as on the closing date of online application): Professor and Additional Professor not exceeding 58 years; Associate Professor and Assistant Professor not exceeding 50 years.
Read the AIIMS Mangalagiri faculty recruitment advertisement No. AIIMS/MG/Admin/Recruitment/03/Faculty/2026/03 fully on aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in before applying.

Online आवेदन 20 नवंबर–31 दिसंबर 2026 तक AIIMS मंगलागिरी exams portal (aiimsmgexams.netlify.app/faculty — 'Go to Applications' candidate login/registration page पर ले जाता है) पर। Hard copy मिलने की last date: 10 जनवरी 2027।
यह re-advertisement है: Advt. No. AIIMS/MG/Admin/Recruitment/01/Faculty/2026/01 दिनांक 11.08.2026 के तहत इन posts के लिए कोई application नहीं आया था।

checklist: Recent colour photograph 3.5 cm × 3.5 cm (JPG, up to 70 KB)
Signature on white paper (JPG, 10–40 KB)
Left thumb impression on white paper (JPG, 10–40 KB)
Matric certificate — name, father's name and date of birth in the form must match it
Educational certificate for the level applied (degree / 12th / ITI / NAC)
Sports achievement certificates (earned on or after 01.04.2024)
Community / EBC / minority certificate and annexures, if claiming the fee concession
documents: Matriculation (10th) certificate — date of birth proof
Educational qualification certificate for your level (degree / 12th / ITI / NAC)
Sports achievement certificates (earned on or after 01.04.2024)
Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC), if applicable — OBC in Central Government format with Non-Creamy Layer
Photo, signature and left thumb impression scans
donts: Do not submit more than one application — multiple applications are invalid.
Do not pay by cash, cheque, money order or demand draft — only online payment is accepted.
Do not sign in capital or disjointed letters, and do not leave any column blank — such forms are rejected.
Do not wait for 30 November — no change of any kind is allowed after final submission.
dos: Check the sports norms for your level and discipline in the notice before paying the fee — the achievement bar decides eligibility.
Apply only through the RRC SER website link (rrcser.co.in > Online/E-Application for Sports Quota (OA)/2026-27).
Keep your Matric certificate details exact — name, father's name, community and date of birth must match it.
Carry originals of date of birth, educational and sports certificates and a photo ID on the trial day.
eligibility: Sports qualification: the minimum sports achievement prescribed for your level, earned on or after 1 April 2024 in a championship conducted by a federation recognised by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports (Level 4/5: represented India at the Olympics (Senior), or at least 3rd position in World Cup / World Championships / Asian Games / Commonwealth Games or other listed events; Level 2/3 and Level 1 norms are given game-wise in the notice).

Education (must be held on the date of application; candidates appearing or awaiting results are not eligible): Level 4/5 — a university degree or equivalent; Level 2/3 — 12th pass, or Matriculation + Course Completed Act Apprenticeship, or 10th pass + ITI / equivalent / NAC from NCVT; Level 1 — 10th pass or ITI or equivalent, or NAC from NCVT.
Age: 18 to 25 years as on 1 January 2027 (date of birth between 02.01.2002 and 01.01.2009). No age relaxation for any category.
Only one application is allowed. No post is reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS — selection is on merit within each sports discipline.
Read Employment Notice No. SER/Pers/Sports Quota/OA/2026-27 fully on rrcser.co.in before applying.

extra_faq.a: Kul 54 posts — Group C Level 4/5 me 5, Group C Level 2/3 me 16 aur Group D Level 1 me 33। Koi post SC/ST/OBC/EWS ke liye reserved nahi hai; selection har sports discipline ke andar merit par hota hai।
extra_faq.q: How many vacancies are there in RRC SER Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?

extra_faq.a: Online form 31 October se 30 November 2026 (raat 11:59) tak rrcser.co.in ke link se bhara jayega। Fee: UR/OBC ₹500 (trial me hazir hone par ₹400 wapas), SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwBD/Women/Minorities/EBC ₹250 (trial me hazir hone par poora wapas)। Sirf online payment chalega।
extra_faq.q: What is the last date and fee for RRC SER Sports Quota 2026-27?

extra_faq.a: Umra 1 January 2027 ko 18–25 saal (koi relaxation nahi)। Level 4/5 ke liye degree, Level 2/3 ke liye 12th pass ya 10th + ITI/Act Apprenticeship/NAC, Level 1 ke liye 10th pass ya ITI/NAC — aur apne level ki prescribed sports achievement, jo 1 April 2024 ya uske baad ki ho।
extra_faq.q: Who can apply for the SER Sports Quota posts?

extra_faq.a: Har discipline ke liye 100 number ki merit: sports achievement 50, sports trial (skill, fitness, coach observation) 40 aur education 10। Qualifying marks: Level 4/5 — 70, Level 2/3 — 65, Level 1 — 60। Uske baad certificate verification aur medical test hota hai। Trial ki dates rrcser.co.in par aayengi।
extra_faq.q: How are candidates selected in RRC SER Sports Quota?

fees: UR/OBC ₹500 — ₹400 is refunded (after bank charges) if you actually appear in the sports trial.
SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwBD/Women/Minorities/EBC ₹250 — the full ₹250 is refunded if you appear in the trial.
Pay online only (Internet Banking / Debit Card / Credit Card). Cash, cheque, money order or demand draft is not accepted.

en.name: RRC South Eastern Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27
en.qual: Level 4/5: a university degree or its equivalent. Level 2/3: 12th pass, or Matriculation + Course Completed Act Apprenticeship, or 10th pass + ITI / equivalent / NAC from NCVT. Level 1: 10th pass or ITI or equivalent, or NAC granted by NCVT. Plus the prescribed sports achievement for the level, earned on or after 01.04.2024 in a championship run by a recognised federation.
specs: 54 posts against Sports Quota (Open Advertisement) 2026-27 in units of South Eastern Railway: Group C Level 4/5 — 5 posts, Group C Level 2/3 — 16 posts, Group D Level 1 — 33 posts. Employment Notice No. SER/Pers/Sports Quota/OA/2026-27 dated 26.10.2026.

Disciplines — Level 4/5: Athletics (Men), Chess (Men), Hockey (Women), Table Tennis (Women). Level 2/3: Athletics (Men), Archery (Men and Women), Body Building (Men), Bridge (Men), Cycling (Men), Gymnastics (Women), Hockey (Men and Women), Rifle Shooting (Women). Level 1: Ball Badminton (Men), Cricket (Men), Football (Men), Golf (Men), Kabaddi (Men and Women), Kho Kho (Men), Volleyball (Men and Women), Water Polo (Men), Weight Lifting (Men). Vacancies are fixed discipline-wise and position-wise in the notice — check your game before applying.
Pay: PB-1 ₹5,200–20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,800/₹2,400 (Level 5/4), ₹2,000/₹1,900 (Level 3/2) and ₹1,800 (Level 1) — 7th CPC Pay Levels 1 to 5.

Selection: merit list out of 100 marks for each discipline — recognised sports achievement 50 marks, sports trial (game skill, physical fitness and coach's observation) 40 marks, educational qualification 10 marks. Minimum qualifying marks: Level 4/5 — 70, Level 2/3 — 65, Level 1 — 60; a trial score below 25 out of 40 does not qualify. Followed by certificate verification and medical examination.

Sports achievements count only if earned on or after 01.04.2024. Volleyball certificates from events of the Volleyball Federation of India or its affiliated units held up to 28.10.2025 and after 21.04.2026 are not considered (National Championship certificates from 29.10.2025 to 21.04.2026 are valid); Body Building results from Indian Body Builders Federation events are not considered.

Trial dates and venues will be announced only on rrcser.co.in. SC/ST candidates get free second-class rail travel to attend the trials. Selected candidates must serve the Railways for 5 years (service bond).
All facts above are taken from Employment Notice No. SER/Pers/Sports Quota/OA/2026-27 of South Eastern Railway (rrcser.co.in).

Age as on 31 October 2026: Chief Manager 27–37 years; Manager 26–36 years; Deputy Manager 24–32 years (relaxation in upper age for reserved categories as per Government of India guidelines).

Eligibility (as on 31 October 2026): B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science / IT / Electronics / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Data Science / AI & ML or an equivalent degree in these disciplines, or M.Sc (Data Science), M.Sc (Statistics/Computer Science), M.A. (Statistics), M.Stat or MCA from a recognised university/institution — with minimum 60% marks or equivalent grade in both Graduation and Post Graduation. No change/correction is allowed after the application window closes.

Apply online 20 November – 10 December 2026 through the link on sbi.bank.in (Careers → Current Openings → Advt CRPD/SCO/2026-27/31). Upload all required documents — an application without them will not be considered for the written exam/shortlisting/interview. Hard copy is NOT to be sent. en.name: SIDBI Grade A & B Recruitment 2026-27
en.qual: Grade A General: Graduation (Commerce/Economics/Maths/Statistics/Business Administration/Engineering) with 60% marks (50% SC/ST/PwBD) or CS/CMA + 2 years' post-qualification officer experience; Hindi/Legal/IT streams have their own degree + 2 years' experience; Grade B: same streams + 5 years' experience (Legal experience as per notification table)
specs: 68 posts — Assistant Manager (Grade A) 63: General 53, Hindi 2, Legal 3, Systems/IT 5 (SC 9, ST 5, OBC 12, EWS 5, UR 32); Manager (Grade B, Specialist only) 5: Hindi 1, Legal 3, Systems/IT 1 (SC 2, UR 3). PwBD horizontal vacancies included (Grade A: HI 2 incl 1 backlog, OC 1, MD/ID 3 incl 2 backlog; Grade B: VI 1, OC 1). Vacancies are provisional.

Pay: Grade A ₹62,500–1,26,100 (17-year scale), minimum gross approx ₹1,20,000 per month, CTC approx ₹30–34 lakh per annum. Grade B ₹78,450–1,41,600 (16-year scale), minimum gross approx ₹1,45,000 per month, CTC approx ₹40–43 lakh per annum.

Age as on 21 November 2026: Grade A 21–30 years (born 21 Nov 1996 to 21 Nov 2005); Grade B 25–33 years (born 21 Nov 1993 to 21 Nov 2001). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC (non-creamy layer) 3 years, PwBD 10 years (13 OBC, 15 SC/ST), Ex-servicemen 5 years, 1984-riot affected 5 years, departmental/staff candidates 5 years.

Eligibility (age cut-off 21 Nov 2026; qualification/experience cut-off 11 Dec 2026): Grade A General — Graduation in Commerce/Economics/Mathematics/Statistics/Business Administration/Engineering with minimum 60% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwBD), OR Company Secretary / Cost and Management Accountant, plus at least 2 years' post-qualification experience as an Officer (permanent/full-time direct contract, not third-party payroll) in lending/credit appraisal, risk, treasury, audit/compliance, venture capital/private equity or debt financing (alternative experience routes are listed in the notification). Grade A Hindi — Bachelor's degree (60%; 55% SC/ST/PwBD) with Hindi and English as subjects for at least 2 years plus a PG Diploma of at least 1 year in Translation, OR a Master's degree in Hindi (50%), plus 2 years' experience in glossary/terminology preparation, translation or Official Language implementation. Grade A Legal — Bachelor's degree in Law (50%; 45% SC/ST/PwBD), enrolled as an advocate, plus 2 years' post-qualification experience as a Law Officer in the listed organisations. Grade A IT — Systems/IT with skill sets AI/ML Automation / Full Stack Application Development / Security / Infrastructure and Network (full discipline/experience detail in the notification, pp.10-12). Grade B Hindi — as Grade A Hindi with at least 5 years' post-qualification experience. Grade B IT — B.E./B.Tech in any discipline (60%; 55% SC/ST/PwBD), preference for Computer Science/IT/Electronics/ECE or allied disciplines, plus at least 5 years' post-qualification experience as an IT/Systems Officer in RBI, SEBI, All-India Financial Institutions, scheduled commercial banks, large corporates, RBI-registered NBFCs/FinTechs/MFIs or AMFI/asset-management companies. Grade B Legal — LLB + enrolled advocate + experience as a Law Officer (experience years as per the notification's detail table).

Selection: Phase I (Paper I, online screening) — 60 marks / 60 minutes: Reasoning 15, English Language 15, Quantitative Aptitude 15, General Awareness (Banking/Financial, Economic/Social, Computer) 15. Phase II (Paper II) — English Descriptive, 3 questions, 75 marks, 60 minutes; (Paper III) — stream-specific Objective 40 questions / 75 marks / 60 minutes plus Subjective 3 questions / 50 marks / 60 minutes; Phase II aggregate 200 marks. Phase I and Phase II are held the same day in a single sitting; Phase II is evaluated only for candidates qualifying Phase I. Phase III — Interview, 100 marks (including weight for notable achievements in extracurricular activities). Interview centres: Chennai, Lucknow, Mumbai and New Delhi.

Dates: online registration and fee payment 21 November–11 December 2026; Phase I & II online exam tentatively 27 December 2026; interview (Phase III) tentatively February 2027. SIDBI reserves the right to change exam dates. Apply only for ONE post under this recruitment exercise.
All facts above are from Advertisement No. 8/Grade 'A' and 'B'/2026-27, SIDBI (54-page detailed notification, sidbi.in).
