en.name: BEML Executive Recruitment 2026
en.qual: Full-time first-class B.E./B.Tech in the relevant engineering discipline (varies by position code 101–137), M.E./M.Tech desirable; post-qualification experience 2 years (Engineer) to 19 years (General Manager); non-engineering posts differ by code
specs: 83 posts by grade: Engineer (Grade II) 56 (UR 24, SC 9, ST 4, OBC 14, EWS 5); Assistant Manager (Grade III) 10 (UR 5, SC 1, ST 1, OBC 2, EWS 1); Manager (Grade IV) 7 (UR 5, SC 1, OBC 1); Senior Manager (Grade V) 1 (UR 1); Assistant General Manager (Grade VI) 5 (UR 4, OBC 1); Deputy General Manager (Grade VII) 3 (UR 2, SC 1); General Manager (Grade VIII) 1 (UR 1). One of the 3 posts for position code 118 (Assistant Manager) is a backlog vacancy for ST. Positions are listed by code 101–137 in the notification.

Age / experience / pay (upper age as on 3 December 2026): Grade II Engineer — 2 years' post-qualification experience, max age 29, ₹40,000–1,40,000; Grade III Assistant Manager — 4 years, max age 30, ₹50,000–1,60,000 (Assistant Manager-Medical, code 123: experience nil, max age 38, same scale); Grade IV Manager — 8 years, max age 34, ₹60,000–1,80,000; Grade V Senior Manager — 11 years, max age 39, ₹70,000–2,00,000; Grade VI AGM — 13 years, max age 42, ₹80,000–2,20,000; Grade VII DGM — 16 years, max age 45, ₹90,000–2,40,000; Grade VIII GM — 19 years, max age 48, ₹1,00,000–2,60,000.

Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC-NCL 3 years, PwD additional 10 years over and above the applicable relaxation (minimum 40% disability); upper age may also be relaxed by equivalent years of excess post-qualification experience, subject to a maximum age of 57 years with relaxation.

Qualification: most engineering posts require a full-time First-Class Degree in the relevant engineering discipline from a recognised University/Institution (discipline varies by position code), with M.E./M.Tech desirable. Examples from the notification: General Manager (code 101, Project Management) — First-Class Degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics Engineering, minimum 19 years' experience including 10 years in Rolling Stock metro contracts; Manager R&D TCMS (code 116) — First-Class Degree in Electronics & Communication/Electrical & Electronics/Instrumentation/Computer Science, minimum 8 years' experience; Engineer Grade II (codes 125, 128, 129, 132, 133, 135) — First-Class Degree in the relevant discipline, minimum 2 years' experience. Non-engineering posts (e.g. Assistant Manager-Medical) differ by code — check the notification table for your code.

Besides basic pay: Variable Dearness Allowance, perquisites/allowances (currently 15.12% of applicable basic pay under the Cafeteria System), company accommodation/HRA, PF, gratuity and PRP as per company rules. Posting across BEML units in India (Bengaluru, Mysore, K.G.F. and others).

Selection: eligible candidates are shortlisted for 'assessment'; based on the assessment, shortlisted candidates undergo pre-employment medical examination and original-document verification. No written-exam pattern or syllabus is given in the notification.

Dates: advertisement dated 16 October 2026; online applications close 3 December 2026 at 6:00 PM. Apply for only ONE position. Helpline: 9205114492, helpdesk.beml@gmail.com (10:00 AM–6:00 PM, Monday–Saturday).
All facts above are from Advertisement No. KP/S/18/2026, BEML (31-page notification, bemlindia.in).

specs: 83 पद grade-wise: इंजीनियर (ग्रेड II) 56 (UR 24, SC 9, ST 4, OBC 14, EWS 5); असिस्टेंट मैनेजर (ग्रेड III) 10 (UR 5, SC 1, ST 1, OBC 2, EWS 1); मैनेजर (ग्रेड IV) 7 (UR 5, SC 1, OBC 1); सीनियर मैनेजर (ग्रेड V) 1 (UR 1); असिस्टेंट जनरल मैनेजर (ग्रेड VI) 5 (UR 4, OBC 1); डिप्टी जनरल मैनेजर (ग्रेड VII) 3 (UR 2, SC 1); जनरल मैनेजर (ग्रेड VIII) 1 (UR 1)। Position code 118 (असिस्टेंट मैनेजर) के 3 पदों में से 1 ST backlog vacancy है। Notification में पद code 101–137 के अनुसार दिए गए हैं।

आयु / अनुभव / pay (upper age 3 दिसंबर 2026 को): ग्रेड II इंजीनियर — 2 साल का post-qualification अनुभव, max age 29, ₹40,000–1,40,000; ग्रेड III असिस्टेंट मैनेजर — 4 साल, max age 30, ₹50,000–1,60,000 (असिस्टेंट मैनेजर-मेडिकल, code 123: अनुभव nil, max age 38, वही scale); ग्रेड IV मैनेजर — 8 साल, max age 34, ₹60,000–1,80,000; ग्रेड V सीनियर मैनेजर — 11 साल, max age 39, ₹70,000–2,00,000; ग्रेड VI AGM — 13 साल, max age 42, ₹80,000–2,20,000; ग्रेड VII DGM — 16 साल, max age 45, ₹90,000–2,40,000; ग्रेड VIII GM — 19 साल, max age 48, ₹1,00,000–2,60,000।

आयु में छूट: SC/ST 5 साल, OBC-NCL 3 साल, PwD को applicable छूट के ऊपर अतिरिक्त 10 साल (कम से कम 40% disability); upper age में excess post-qualification अनुभव के बराबर सालों की छूट भी मिल सकती है, छूट सहित maximum age 57 साल।

Qualification: ज़्यादातर इंजीनियरिंग पदों के लिए मान्यता प्राप्त University/Institution से संबंधित engineering discipline में full-time First-Class Degree चाहिए (discipline position code के अनुसार अलग है), M.E./M.Tech desirable। Notification के उदाहरण: जनरल मैनेजर (code 101, Project Management) — Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics Engineering में First-Class Degree, कम से कम 19 साल का अनुभव, जिसमें 10 साल Rolling Stock metro contracts में; मैनेजर R&D TCMS (code 116) — Electronics & Communication/Electrical & Electronics/Instrumentation/Computer Science में First-Class Degree, कम से कम 8 साल का अनुभव; इंजीनियर ग्रेड II (codes 125, 128, 129, 132, 133, 135) — संबंधित discipline में First-Class Degree, कम से कम 2 साल का अनुभव। Non-engineering पद (जैसे असिस्टेंट मैनेजर-मेडिकल) code के अनुसार अलग हैं — अपने code की notification table देखें।

Basic pay के अलावा: Variable Dearness Allowance, perquisites/allowances (वर्तमान में applicable basic pay का 15.12%, Cafeteria System के तहत), company accommodation/HRA, PF, gratuity और PRP company rules के अनुसार। Posting भारत भर की BEML units में (बेंगलुरु, मैसूर, K.G.F. और अन्य)।

चयन: eligible candidates को 'assessment' के लिए shortlist किया जाएगा; उसके आधार पर shortlisted candidates की pre-employment medical examination और original-document verification होगी। Notification में written-exam pattern या syllabus नहीं दिया गया है।

donts: Do not pay the fee by any mode other than NEFT — no other payment mode is accepted.

dos: Read Advertisement No. NSIC/HR/01/2026 fully on nsic.co.in before applying — check the exact qualification, experience and age for your post.
Apply only through the official NSIC careers portal (career.nsic.co.in) between 21 November and 14 December 2026.
Pay ₹1,500 by NEFT only (SBI A/c 43207132490, IFSC SBIN0004298) and upload the NEFT receipt in the form — SC/ST/PwBD, women and departmental candidates are exempt.
Send the hard copy of the application with documents to DGM (HR), NSIC Bhawan, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi-110020 by 21 December 2026, 6:00 PM.
eligibility: This is a Special Recruitment Drive — only SC/ST/OBC candidates (including PwBD) can apply for these 42 posts.
General Manager (E-5): Graduation + 2-year MBA (first class 60%, Marketing/Finance) or CA/CMA + 15 years' experience, max age 45.
DGM Technical (E-4): first-class B.E./B.Tech (60%, Electrical/ECE/IT) + 12 years' experience, max age 41; DGM (F&A): CA/CMA or B.Com + 2-year MBA Finance (first class 60%) + 12 years, max age 41.
Chief Manager (E-3): 9 years' experience, max age 38 — Law: first-class LLB/5-year integrated law (60%); F&A: CA/CMA or B.Com + 2-year MBA Finance (first class 60%).

Deputy Manager (E-1): 2 years' experience, max age 31; Assistant Manager (E-0): no experience needed, max age 28 — Technical: first-class 4-year B.E./B.Tech (60%) in the listed branches; F&A: CA/CMA or B.Com + 2-year MBA Finance (first class 60%).
Age relaxation: SC/ST 5, OBC-NCL 3, PwBD 10 (15 SC/ST, 13 OBC), Ex-SM 5 years. Read Advt NSIC/HR/01/2026 fully on nsic.co.in before applying.

specs: 41 regular posts: Chief General Manager (HR) (E-7, ₹1,00,000–2,60,000) 1 (UR 1), experience 21 years, max age 55; Deputy General Manager Technical/Business Development (E-4) 3 (UR 3), experience 12 years, max age 41; Chief Manager Technical (E-3) 5 (SC 1, ST 1, UR 3), experience 9 years, max age 38; Manager Law (E-2, ₹50,000–1,60,000) 2 (UR 2), experience 5 years, max age 34; Manager (F&A) (E-2) 6 (SC 1, ST 1, OBC 1, UR 3), experience 5 years, max age 34; Deputy Manager (E-1) Law & Recovery / Contract & Procurement / Rajbhasha / Business Development / Civil 7 (SC 1, OBC 1, UR 5), experience 2 years, max age 31; Deputy Manager (F&A) (E-1) 4 (UR 4), experience 2 years, max age 31; Assistant Manager Technical (E-0) 11 (SC 1, OBC 2, EWS 1, UR 7), experience nil, max age 28; Assistant Manager (F&A) (E-0) 2 (UR 2), experience nil, max age 28. Category totals: SC 4, ST 2, OBC 4, EWS 1, UR 30.
Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC-NCL 3 years, PwBD 10 years (15 for SC/ST-PwBD, 13 for OBC-PwBD), Ex-Servicemen 5 years.

Qualification: Chief General Manager (HR) — Graduation + MBA (first class, 60%, HRM/HRD/PM&IR/Labour Welfare); DGM Technical — first-class B.E./B.Tech (60%, ECE/IT/CS); Chief Manager Technical — first-class B.E./B.Tech (60%, Civil/Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/E&E/IT/CS); Manager Law — first-class LLB (60%); F&A posts — CA/CMA or B.Com + 2-year MBA Finance (first class, 60%). 5% marks relaxation for SC/ST/PwBD where stated in the notification.

Selection: posts 1–7 (CGM to Deputy Manager) — scrutiny of applications followed by interview. Assistant Manager Technical — GATE 2025/2026 score 70% + interview 30%. Assistant Manager (F&A) — Computer Based Test 70% + interview 30%; the CBT is 100 MCQs, 100 marks, 90 minutes, with −0.25 negative marking, qualifying marks 40 for General/OBC and 35 for SC/ST/PwBD.

Dates: online registration 21 November–14 December 2026; hard copy of the application with documents must reach DGM (HR), NSIC Bhawan, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi-110020 by 21 December 2026, 6:00 PM. Fee by NEFT only. Contact: recruitment@nsic.co.in, 011-26926275.

All facts above are from Advertisement No. NSIC/HR/02/2026, NSIC (14-page notification, nsic.co.in). This is the regular recruitment — separate from the Special Drive (Advt NSIC/HR/01/2026, 42 posts).

Do not use the same email ID for two posts — each post needs a separate form and a unique email ID.

Do not apply for a post whose notified experience area does not match yours — experience other than the notified area will not be considered, and qualifications other than the notified branch will not be considered.
Do not wait for the last day — registration closes 19 December 2026 at 5:00 PM and fee payment at 11:45 PM.
dos: Read Advertisement No. 11/2026 fully on nlcindia.in before applying — check the exact qualification, experience and age for your post (25 different posts).
Apply only through the official NLC recruitment portal (web.nlcindia.in/rec112026) between 20 November and 19 December 2026, 5:00 PM.
Use a separate application and a unique email ID for each post you apply for — and upload documentary proof of the required area and length of experience.
Pay the fee by 19 December 2026, 11:45 PM (₹854 UR/EWS/OBC; ₹354 SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-SM) via SBI E-Collect; complete the final submission by 22 December 2026, 5:00 PM.
Check the private-sector minimum CTC rule (50%/60%/70% of the grade CTC) before applying — it applies at application and at interview/selection.
eligibility: LATERAL recruitment — you must be in employment at the time of application and at interview/selection, and must be properly relieved at joining.

Deputy General Manager E-7 (Mechanical/Electrical/Civil): Bachelor Degree in the relevant discipline + 19 years' experience, including 5 years in Coal/Lignite Thermal Power Projects of 500 MW or above (Civil: 19 years in the power sector, 5 years in planning/construction/execution of power projects).

Executive Engineer E-4: Bachelor Degree in the relevant discipline + 5 years in the notified area (Thermal/Mines/Projects/C&I/Environmental/Chemical/Mining/Safety); Executive Engineer (Mining) also needs a First Class Mine Manager Certificate of Competency under Coal Mine Regulations, 2017.
Assistant Executive Manager (Scientific) E-2: M.Sc. Chemistry (Analytical/Organic/Inorganic/Physical) + 4 years' R&D/Analytical experience in Fuel/Water Laboratories of Thermal Power Plants.

Deputy Manager (HR) E-3: Degree + PG in HR/Social Work/Business Administration or PG Degree/Diploma of at least 2 years in HRM/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare + 1 year in HR/Personnel/IR/Labour welfare/HRD.
Deputy Manager (Legal) E-3: LLB + enrolled as an Advocate + 1 year as a practising advocate or in a Legal Department of a PSU/Nationalised Bank/Government/listed company.

Additional Chief Manager (Security) E-6: any degree + the specified Armed Forces/paramilitary service (Major/Commandant or above, 5 years in security management) or Chief/In-charge of security in a 10,000+ workforce organisation with 13 years' executive experience. Assistant Manager (Security) E-1: any degree + Hon'ry Lieutenant/Captain rank or Executive/In-Charge Security in a 5,000+ workforce organisation.

Age as on 1 November 2026 (already including relaxations): E-7 52/55/57/57, E-6 47/50/52/52, E-4 36/39/41/41, E-3 32/35/37/37, E-2 30/33/35/35, E-1 30/33/35/35 (UR/EWS, OBC, SC, ST). Maximum age 58 years. Read Advt No. 11/2026 fully on nlcindia.in before applying.

en.name: NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026
en.qual: Full-time/part-time Bachelor Degree in the relevant engineering discipline (Mechanical/Electrical/Civil/C&I/Environmental/Chemical/Mining) or M.Sc. Chemistry (Scientific) or LLB + advocate enrolment (Legal) or PG in HR (Deputy Manager HR) or any degree with the specified Armed Forces/paramilitary service (Security); experience 1–19 years post-qualification, depending on grade
specs: 145 posts in 25 rows (Advt. No. 11/2026): Mechanical 52 — Deputy General Manager (Thermal) E-7 1 (ST 1), Executive Engineer (Thermal) E-4 7 (UR 3, EWS 1, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1), Executive Engineer (Mines) E-4 40 (UR 11, EWS 4, OBC 9, SC 7, ST 9), Executive Engineer (Projects) E-4 4 (UR 1, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1); Electrical 30 — Deputy General Manager (Thermal) E-7 1 (OBC 1), Executive Engineer (Thermal) E-4 6 (UR 3, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1), Executive Engineer (Mines) E-4 20 (UR 8, EWS 2, OBC 3, SC 3, ST 4), Executive Engineer (Projects) E-4 3 (UR 1, SC 1, ST 1); Civil 17 — Deputy General Manager (Thermal) E-7 2 (OBC 1, ST 1), Executive Engineer (Thermal) E-4 5 (UR 2, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1), Executive Engineer (Mines) E-4 8 (UR 1, EWS 1, OBC 2, SC 2, ST 2), Executive Engineer (Projects)–I E-4 1 (OBC 1), Executive Engineer (Projects)–II E-4 1 (UR 1); Control & Instrumentation (Thermal) E-4 4 (UR 3, ST 1); Environmental Engineering (Mines) E-4 2 (OBC 1, ST 1); Scientific 9 — Assistant Executive Manager (Thermal) E-2 5 (UR 2, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1), Assistant Executive Manager (Projects) E-2 4 (UR 2, OBC 1, SC 1); Chemical 5 — Executive Engineer (Thermal) E-4 4 (UR 1, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1), Executive Engineer (Projects) E-4 1 (UR 1); Mining — Executive Engineer (Mining) E-4 12 (UR 5, EWS 1, OBC 3, SC 1, ST 2); Safety (Projects) E-4 1 (UR 1); Human Resources — Deputy Manager (HR) E-3 7 (UR 3, OBC 2, SC 1, ST 1); Legal — Deputy Manager (Legal) E-3 3 (UR 3); Security — Additional Chief Manager (Security) E-6 2 (UR 2), Assistant Manager (Security) E-1 1 (UR 1). By grade: E-7 4, E-6 2, E-4 119, E-3 10, E-2 9, E-1 1 — total 145. PwBD reservation is horizontal (DoPT/GoI directives); asterisked entries are carried-forward reservations of Advt. No. 18/2024.

Pay (IDA, with approximate CTC per annum): E-7 ₹1,00,000–2,60,000 (CTC approx ₹29.02 lakh), E-6 ₹90,000–2,40,000 (approx ₹26.12 lakh), E-4 ₹70,000–2,00,000 (approx ₹20.32 lakh), E-3 ₹60,000–1,80,000 (approx ₹17.42 lakh), E-2 ₹50,000–1,60,000 (approx ₹14.50 lakh). No E-1 pay scale or CTC is stated in the notification. Plus Performance Related Pay (annual), medical treatment for self and dependents, Group Insurance and eligible residential accommodation in Company Townships. Probation: 1 year. Posting: liable to be posted to any Unit/Area/Place under NLCIL or its JV/Associate/Subsidiary in different States/UTs.

Age limits as on the crucial date 1 November 2026 (these figures already include the relaxations): E-7 — UR/EWS 52, OBC 55, SC/ST 57; E-6 — 47/50/52/52; E-4 — 36/39/41/41; E-3 — 32/35/37/37; E-2 — 30/33/35/35; E-1 — 30/33/35/35. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC (NCL) 3 years, PwBD 10 years (13 for PwBD-OBC, 15 for PwBD-SC/ST), Ex-Servicemen as per GoI rules. Upper age limit does not apply to employees currently on the rolls of NLCIL or its Subsidiary/JV, subject to a minimum of 2 years' remaining service as on the crucial date. Maximum age in all cases is 58 years as on the crucial date.

This is a LATERAL recruitment: candidates must be in employment at the time of application and at interview/selection, and must be properly relieved at joining. CPSE/State PSE/Central/State Government/Public Sector Bank candidates need a minimum of 2 years in the immediate lower scale of pay (or equivalent) out of the total required experience — except Deputy Manager (HR)/Deputy Manager (Legal) (E-3), where 1 year in the immediate lower scale suffices. Candidates already in the same/equivalent or higher scale are exempt from that condition. NLCIL employees need a minimum of 1 year in the immediate lower scale and immediate lower designation. Private-sector candidates (including practising advocates) must be drawing a CTC of not less than 50% of the CTC of the E-2/E-3/E-4 grade (for E-2/E-3/E-4 posts respectively), 60% of the E-6 CTC (E-6 posts) and 70% of the E-7 CTC (E-7 posts).

Qualification and experience (all experience is post-qualification): Deputy General Manager E-7 (Mechanical/Electrical/Civil) — Bachelor Degree in the relevant discipline + 19 years, including a minimum of 5 years in Construction/Erection/Commissioning/Execution of Coal/Lignite Thermal Power Projects with individual unit capacity of 500 MW or above (Civil: 19 years in power-sector organisations with individual unit 200 MW or above, minimum 5 years in planning, construction and execution of power projects). Executive Engineer E-4 — Bachelor Degree in the relevant discipline + 5 years in the notified area (e.g. Mechanical Thermal: Power Station Design/EPC/Construction/Erection/Commissioning/Operation/Maintenance in Coal/Lignite Thermal Power Stations, unit 200 MW or above; Mechanical Mines: Opencast/Underground Mine or HEMM erection/commissioning/maintenance; Projects posts: 5 years in Thermal Power Plant/Mines/Renewable sector with a minimum of 3 years in Materials Management). Assistant Executive Manager (Scientific) E-2 — M.Sc. Chemistry (Analytical/Organic/Inorganic/Physical) + 4 years' R&D/Analytical experience in Chemistry in Fuel/Water Laboratories of Thermal Power Plants. Executive Engineer (Mining) E-4 — Degree in Mining Engineering + First Class Mine Manager Certificate of Competency under Coal Mine Regulations, 2017 + 5 years in Opencast/Underground Mine. Executive Engineer (Safety) E-4 — full-time Bachelor Degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Power/Civil/Chemical/Mining Engineering + Diploma in Industrial Safety (DGFASLI institute or full-time diploma of at least 1 year from a University/Board of Technical Education), the diploma completed after the Engineering degree, + 5 years including a minimum of 3 years as a notified safety officer in a Thermal power plant/Mines. Deputy Manager (HR) E-3 — Degree in any discipline + PG Degree in Social Work/Business Administration/Business Management with specialisation in Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare, or PG Degree/Diploma of at least 2 years in Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/HRM/Labour Welfare/Labour Management/Labour Administration/Labour Studies (additional Law degree desirable) + 1 year in HR/Personnel/Industrial Relations/Labour welfare/HRD. Deputy Manager (Legal) E-3 — LLB (3-year or 5-year) + enrolled as an Advocate with any State Bar Council + 1 year as a practising advocate handling Labour & Service, Commercial Contracts, Taxation, Revenue, Land Acquisition, Arbitration and other civil laws, or 1 year in the Legal Department of a State/Central PSU/Nationalised Bank/Government or listed company. Additional Chief Manager (Security) E-6 — any degree + service in the rank of Major or above (Army) or equivalent (Navy/Air Force) with at least 5 years' direct exposure to Security Management, OR Commandant or above from CISF/Police (Substantive) with at least 5 years in an industry, OR Commandant or above from other Para Military Forces/CAPF with at least 5 years' direct exposure to security management, OR Chief/In-charge of security in an organisation with a workforce of at least 10,000 with at least 13 years' experience in the executive position. Assistant Manager (Security) E-1 — any degree + service in the rank of Hon'ry Lieutenant/Captain or equivalent before discharge from the Armed Forces/CAPF, OR experience as Executive/In-Charge Security in an organisation with a workforce of at least 5,000 (no length of experience in years is stated for this post).

Selection: Legal discipline only — Written Test (80 marks) through CBT on Professional Knowledge, followed by Personal Interview (20 marks); minimum qualifying in the Written Test is 50%; candidates who qualify are shortlisted 1:6 for the Interview after scrutiny; final selection by order of merit out of 100 (80+20). All other disciplines — selection based on Personal Interview only; if the response for a post is higher than 1:6, management may conduct a Screening Test (CBT) and shortlist 1:6 for the Interview after scrutiny; minimum qualifying marks in the Interview are 50% for UR/EWS and 40% for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts. Pre-employment medical fitness applies.

Dates: crucial date 1 November 2026 (used for category status, upper age limit, fee concession, reservation and experience). Online registration opens 20 November 2026 at 10:00 AM and closes 19 December 2026 at 5:00 PM; last date for online fee payment 19 December 2026, 11:45 PM; last date for online submission for candidates who already registered and paid the fee within the time limit — 22 December 2026, 5:00 PM. A separate Registration-cum-Application Form, fee receipt and enclosures are needed for each post applied for, with a unique email ID per post. Help: help.recruitment@nlcindia.in.
All facts above are from Advertisement No. 11/2026, NLC India Limited (13-page detailed notification, nlcindia.in).

डिप्टी जनरल मैनेजर E-7 (Mechanical/Electrical/Civil): संबंधित discipline में बैचलर डिग्री + 19 साल का अनुभव, जिनमें 5 साल 500 MW या ऊपर के Coal/Lignite Thermal Power Projects में (Civil: power sector में 19 साल, 5 साल power projects की planning/construction/execution में)।

एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर E-4: संबंधित discipline में बैचलर डिग्री + notified area में 5 साल (Thermal/Mines/Projects/C&I/Environmental/Chemical/Mining/Safety); एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Mining) को Coal Mine Regulations, 2017 के तहत First Class Mine Manager Certificate of Competency भी चाहिए।
असिस्टेंट एग्जीक्यूटिव मैनेजर (Scientific) E-2: M.Sc. Chemistry (Analytical/Organic/Inorganic/Physical) + Thermal Power Plants की Fuel/Water Laboratories में 4 साल का R&D/Analytical अनुभव।

डिप्टी मैनेजर (HR) E-3: किसी भी discipline में डिग्री + HR/Social Work/Business Administration में PG या HRM/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare में कम से कम 2 साल का PG Degree/Diploma + 1 साल HR/Personnel/IR/Labour welfare/HRD में।
डिप्टी मैनेजर (Legal) E-3: LLB + अधिवक्ता के रूप में नामांकित + 1 साल practising advocate के रूप में या किसी PSU/Nationalised Bank/Government/listed company के Legal Department में।

एडिशनल चीफ मैनेजर (Security) E-6: कोई भी degree + तय Armed Forces/paramilitary सेवा (Major/Commandant या ऊपर, 5 साल security management में) या 10,000+ workforce वाले organisation में Chief/In-charge of security, 13 साल executive अनुभव के साथ। असिस्टेंट मैनेजर (Security) E-1: कोई भी degree + Hon'ry Lieutenant/Captain rank या 5,000+ workforce वाले organisation में Executive/In-Charge Security।

Chemistry (Scientific) या LLB + अधिवक्ता नामांकन (Legal) या HR में PG (डिप्टी मैनेजर HR) या तय Armed Forces/paramilitary सेवा के साथ कोई भी degree (Security); grade के अनुसार 1–19 साल का post-qualification अनुभव
specs: 145 पद, 25 rows (Advt. No. 11/2026): Mechanical 52 — डिप्टी जनरल मैनेजर (Thermal) E-7 1 (ST 1), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Thermal) E-4 7 (UR 3, EWS 1, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Mines) E-4 40 (UR 11, EWS 4, OBC 9, SC 7, ST 9), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Projects) E-4 4 (UR 1, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1); Electrical 30 — डिप्टी जनरल मैनेजर (Thermal) E-7 1 (OBC 1), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Thermal) E-4 6 (UR 3, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Mines) E-4 20 (UR 8, EWS 2, OBC 3, SC 3, ST 4), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Projects) E-4 3 (UR 1, SC 1, ST 1); Civil 17 — डिप्टी जनरल मैनेजर (Thermal) E-7 2 (OBC 1, ST 1), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Thermal) E-4 5 (UR 2, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Mines) E-4 8 (UR 1, EWS 1, OBC 2, SC 2, ST 2), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Projects)–I E-4 1 (OBC 1), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Projects)–II E-4 1 (UR 1); कंट्रोल और इंस्ट्रूमेंटेशन (Thermal) E-4 4 (UR 3, ST 1); एनवायरनमेंटल इंजीनियरिंग (Mines) E-4 2 (OBC 1, ST 1); Scientific 9 — असिस्टेंट एग्जीक्यूटिव मैनेजर (Thermal) E-2 5 (UR 2, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1), असिस्टेंट एग्जीक्यूटिव मैनेजर (Projects) E-2 4 (UR 2, OBC 1, SC 1); Chemical 5 — एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Thermal) E-4 4 (UR 1, OBC 1, SC 1, ST 1), एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Projects) E-4 1 (UR 1); Mining — एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Mining) E-4 12 (UR 5, EWS 1, OBC 3, SC 1, ST 2); Safety (Projects) E-4 1 (UR 1); Human Resources — डिप्टी मैनेजर (HR) E-3 7 (UR 3, OBC 2, SC 1, ST 1); Legal — डिप्टी मैनेजर (Legal) E-3 3 (UR 3); Security — एडिशनल चीफ मैनेजर (Security) E-6 2 (UR 2), असिस्टेंट मैनेजर (Security) E-1 1 (UR 1)। Grade-wise: E-7 4, E-6 2, E-4 119, E-3 10, E-2 9, E-1 1 — कुल 145। PwBD reservation horizontal है (DoPT/GoI directives); asterisk (*) वाले entries Advt. No. 18/2024 की carried-forward reservations हैं।

Pay (IDA, approximate CTC प्रति वर्ष के साथ): E-7 ₹1,00,000–2,60,000 (CTC लगभग ₹29.02 लाख), E-6 ₹90,000–2,40,000 (लगभग ₹26.12 लाख), E-4 ₹70,000–2,00,000 (लगभग ₹20.32 लाख), E-3 ₹60,000–1,80,000 (लगभग ₹17.42 लाख), E-2 ₹50,000–1,60,000 (लगभग ₹14.50 लाख)। Notification में E-1 का कोई pay scale या CTC नहीं दिया गया है। इसके अलावा Performance Related Pay (सालाना), खुद और dependents का medical treatment, Group Insurance और Company Townships में eligible residential accommodation। Probation: 1 साल। Posting: NLCIL या उसकी JV/Associate/Subsidiary की किसी भी Unit/Area/Place पर, अलग-अलग States/UTs में।

आयु सीमा crucial date 1 नवंबर 2026 को (ये आंकड़े छूट सहित हैं): E-7 — UR/EWS 52, OBC 55, SC/ST 57; E-6 — 47/50/52/52; E-4 — 36/39/41/41; E-3 — 32/35/37/37; E-2 — 30/33/35/35; E-1 — 30/33/35/35। छूट: SC/ST 5 साल, OBC (NCL) 3 साल, PwBD 10 साल (PwBD-OBC 13, PwBD-SC/ST 15), भूतपूर्व सैनिक GoI नियमों के अनुसार। Upper age limit उन कर्मचारियों पर लागू नहीं होती जो currently NLCIL या उसकी Subsidiary/JV के rolls पर हैं, बशर्ते crucial date को कम से कम 2 साल की सेवा बची हो। सभी cases में maximum age 58 साल है (crucial date को)।

यह LATERAL भर्ती है: उम्मीदवार को application के समय और interview/selection के समय नौकरी में होना चाहिए, और joining पर properly relieved होना होगा। CPSE/State PSE/Central/State Government/Public Sector Bank के उम्मीदवारों को कुल required experience में से कम से कम 2 साल immediate lower scale of pay (या equivalent) में चाहिए — डिप्टी मैनेजर (HR)/डिप्टी मैनेजर (Legal) (E-3) के लिए 1 साल काफ़ी है। जो उम्मीदवार पहले से same/equivalent या higher scale में हैं, वे इस शर्त से छूट पाते हैं। NLCIL के कर्मचारियों को immediate lower scale और immediate lower designation में कम से कम 1 साल चाहिए। Private-sector उम्मीदवारों (practising advocates सहित) को application और interview/selection के समय CTC कम से कम 50% होना चाहिए — E-2/E-3/E-4 grade के CTC का (E-2/E-3/E-4 पदों के लिए), E-6 CTC का 60% (E-6 पदों के लिए) और E-7 CTC का 70% (E-7 पदों के लिए)।

Qualification और अनुभव (सारा अनुभव post-qualification है): डिप्टी जनरल मैनेजर E-7 (Mechanical/Electrical/Civil) — संबंधित discipline में बैचलर डिग्री + 19 साल, जिनमें कम से कम 5 साल Construction/Erection/Commissioning/Execution of Coal/Lignite Thermal Power Projects में, individual unit capacity 500 MW या ऊपर (Civil: power-sector organisations में 19 साल, individual unit 200 MW या ऊपर, कम से कम 5 साल planning, construction और execution of power projects में)। एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर E-4 — संबंधित discipline में बैचलर डिग्री + 5 साल notified area में (जैसे Mechanical Thermal: Power Station Design/EPC/Construction/Erection/Commissioning/Operation/Maintenance in Coal/Lignite Thermal Power Stations, unit 200 MW या ऊपर; Mechanical Mines: Opencast/Underground Mine या HEMM erection/commissioning/maintenance; Projects पद: Thermal Power Plant/Mines/Renewable sector में 5 साल, जिनमें कम से कम 3 साल Materials Management में)। असिस्टेंट एग्जीक्यूटिव मैनेजर (Scientific) E-2 — M.Sc. Chemistry (Analytical/Organic/Inorganic/Physical) + 4 साल का R&D/Analytical अनुभव Chemistry में, Thermal Power Plants की Fuel/Water Laboratories में। एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Mining) E-4 — Mining Engineering में डिग्री + Coal Mine Regulations, 2017 के तहत First Class Mine Manager Certificate of Competency + 5 साल Opencast/Underground Mine में। एग्जीक्यूटिव इंजीनियर (Safety) E-4 — Mechanical/Electrical/Power/Civil/Chemical/Mining Engineering में full-time बैचलर डिग्री + Industrial Safety में Diploma (DGFASLI institute से या कम से कम 1 साल का full-time diploma, University/Board of Technical Education से), diploma Engineering degree के बाद पूरा हुआ हो, + 5 साल, जिनमें कम से कम 3 साल Thermal power plant/Mines में notified safety officer के रूप में। डिप्टी मैनेजर (HR) E-3 — किसी भी discipline में डिग्री + Social Work/Business Administration/Business Management में PG Degree (Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare में specialisation), या Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/HRM/Labour Welfare/Labour Management/Labour Administration/Labour Studies में कम से कम 2 साल का PG Degree/Diploma (Law में अतिरिक्त डिग्री desirable) + 1 साल HR/Personnel/Industrial Relations/Labour welfare/HRD में। डिप्टी मैनेजर (Legal) E-3 — LLB (3 साल या 5 साल) + किसी भी State Bar Council में अधिवक्ता के रूप में नामांकित + 1 साल practising advocate के रूप में (Labour & Service, Commercial Contracts, Taxation, Revenue, Land Acquisition, Arbitration और अन्य civil laws) या 1 साल State/Central PSU/Nationalised Bank/Government या listed company के Legal Department में। एडिशनल चीफ मैनेजर (Security) E-6 — कोई भी degree + Army में Major या उससे ऊपर के rank (या Navy/Air Force में equivalent) में service, कम से कम 5 साल Security Management में direct exposure, या CISF/Police (Substantive) में Commandant या ऊपर, जिनमें कम से कम 5 साल industry में, या अन्य Para Military Forces/CAPF में Commandant या ऊपर, कम से कम 5 साल security management में direct exposure, या कम से कम 10,000 workforce वाले organisation में Chief/In-charge of security, कम से कम 13 साल executive position में अनुभव। असिस्टेंट मैनेजर (Security) E-1 — कोई भी degree + Armed Forces/CAPF से discharge से पहले Hon'ry Lieutenant/Captain या equivalent rank में service, या कम से कम 5,000 workforce वाले organisation में Executive/In-Charge Security के रूप में अनुभव (इस पद के लिए अनुभव की अवधि सालों में notification में नहीं दी गई है)।

चयन: सिर्फ Legal discipline — Written Test (CBT, Professional Knowledge पर, 80 अंक) + Personal Interview (20 अंक); Written Test में कम से कम 50% qualifying है; qualify करने वाले scrutiny के बाद 1:6 के ratio में Interview के लिए shortlist होंगे; final selection 100 में से merit के आधार पर (80+20)। बाकी सभी disciplines — सिर्फ Personal Interview पर चयन; अगर किसी पद के लिए response 1:6 से ज़्यादा हुआ तो management Screening Test (CBT) कर सकता है और scrutiny के बाद 1:6 में Interview के लिए shortlist करेगा; Interview में qualifying अंक: UR/EWS 50%, SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD 40% (reserved posts के लिए)। Pre-employment medical fitness लागू है।

Dates: crucial date 1 नवंबर 2026 (category status, upper age limit, fee concession, reservation और अनुभव के लिए)। ऑनलाइन registration 20 नवंबर 2026, सुबह 10:00 बजे से 19 दिसंबर 2026, शाम 5:00 बजे तक; ऑनलाइन fee payment की आखिरी तारीख 19 दिसंबर 2026, रात 11:45 बजे; जिन्होंने समय पर register करके fee भर दी है, उनके लिए ऑनलाइन submission की आखिरी तारीख — 22 दिसंबर 2026, शाम 5:00 बजे। हर post के लिए अलग Registration-cum-Application Form, fee receipt और enclosures चाहिए, हर post के लिए unique email ID। Help: help.recruitment@nlcindia.in।

en.name: Bihar Vidhan Sabha ASO & Assistant Caretaker Recruitment 2026
en.qual: Graduation or equivalent from a recognised university, for both posts, to be held by the last date (27 November 2026)
specs: 84 posts (revised in the re-open notice dated 03/11/2026): Assistant Section Officer (ASO) 79 — Unreserved 43, EWS 8, SC 7, Extremely Backward 12, Backward 7, Backward Women 2 (23 of 79 reserved for women under 35% horizontal reservation); Assistant Caretaker 5 — Unreserved 2, EWS 1, Extremely Backward 1, Backward 1 (3 of 5 for women). The original January 2024 advertisement had only 50 ASO posts.
Pay: ASO Pay Level-7, ₹44,900–₹1,42,400 plus allowances; Assistant Caretaker Pay Level-4, ₹25,500–₹81,100 plus allowances.

Age: minimum 21 years as on 01.08.2023. Maximum: Unreserved male 37 years; Unreserved female, BC and EBC (male and female) 40 years; SC and ST (male and female) 42 years. Relaxation: government servants with 3 years' continuous service 5 years; Divyangjan 10 years beyond the maximum; ex-servicemen 3 years plus service period (actual age on the last date must not exceed 53 years). Age is calculated from the matriculation certificate date of birth.
Qualification: Graduation or equivalent from a recognised university, for both posts. Reservation benefit only for permanent residents of Bihar.

Selection: (1) Preliminary exam — objective/MCQ, OMR-based, 100 questions, 400 marks (4 marks each, −1 for a wrong answer): General Studies 40, General Science & Maths 30, Mental Ability & Logical Reasoning 30. Qualifying marks: General 40%, BC 36.5%, EBC 34%, SC/ST, women and Divyang 32%. en.name: NTA SHRESHTA (NETS) 2027
en.qual: SC or De-notified Tribe (DNT) student seeking admission to Class 9 or Class 11 (detailed eligibility, syllabus and exam cities are in the Information Bulletin)
specs: SHRESHTA (NETS) 2027 — National Entrance Test for the Scheme for Residential Education for Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas — is conducted by NTA on behalf of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. It gives high-quality education to meritorious SC and De-notified Tribe (DNT, not covered under SCs, STs and OBCs) students, boys and girls, in reputed private residential schools.
Seats: about 2,400 students (2,160 SC + 240 DNT) are selected for admission to Class 9 and Class 11. The entire cost of education is funded by the Central Government.

Who can apply: SC and DNT students, boys and girls, seeking admission to Class 9 and Class 11. Detailed eligibility, syllabus, exam cities and passing requirements are in the 50-page Information Bulletin.
Exam: 10 January 2027 (Sunday), 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM; bilingual (Hindi & English), Multiple Choice Questions, Pen-and-Paper (OMR) mode, in 192 cities.

Dates: online submission 14 November–30 November 2026 (up to 11:50 PM); correction window 2–4 December 2026; city intimation 20 December 2026; admit cards from 3 January 2027; exam 10 January 2027; result date to be intimated later.

Apply only through the official NTA portal — the application portal link is on exams.nta.nic.in (the portal's own URL is session-bound, so reach it from the exams.nta.nic.in apply page). Help desk: 011-40759000 / 69227700, shreshta@nta.ac.in.

hi.name: NTA SHRESHTA (NETS) 2027
hi.qual: Class 9 या Class 11 में प्रवेश चाहने वाला SC या विमुक्त जनजाति (DNT) विद्यार्थी (विस्तृत eligibility, syllabus और exam cities Information Bulletin में)
specs: SHRESHTA (NETS) 2027 — Targeted Areas में High Schools में विद्यार्थियों के लिए आवासीय शिक्षा योजना की National Entrance Test — NTA द्वारा सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता मंत्रालय की ओर से आयोजित की जाती है। यह मेधावी SC और विमुक्त जनजाति (DNT, जो SC/ST/OBC में नहीं आते) के छात्र-छात्राओं को प्रतिष्ठित निजी आवासीय विद्यालयों में उच्च गुणवत्ता की शिक्षा देती है।
Seats: लगभग 2,400 विद्यार्थियों (2,160 SC + 240 DNT) का चयन Class 9 और Class 11 में प्रवेश के लिए होता है। शिक्षा का पूरा खर्च केंद्र सरकार वहन करती है।
कौन apply कर सकता है: Class 9 या Class 11 में प्रवेश चाहने वाले SC और DNT छात्र-छात्राएँ। विस्तृत eligibility, syllabus, exam cities और passing requirements 50-page Information Bulletin में हैं।
Exam: 10 जनवरी 2027 (रविवार), दोपहर 2:00 से 5:00 बजे तक; द्विभाषी (Hindi & English), Multiple Choice Questions, Pen-and-Paper (OMR) mode, 192 शहरों में।

Dates: ऑनलाइन आवेदन 14 नवंबर – 30 नवंबर 2026 (रात 11:50 बजे तक); correction window 2–4 दिसंबर 2026; city intimation 20 दिसंबर 2026; admit card 3 जनवरी 2027 से; exam 10 जनवरी 2027; result की तारीख बाद में बताई जाएगी।

सिर्फ official NTA portal से apply करें — application portal का link exams.nta.nic.in पर है (portal का अपना URL session-bound है, इसलिए exams.nta.nic.in के apply page से जाएँ)। Help desk: 011-40759000 / 69227700, shreshta@nta.ac.in।
ऊपर के सभी तथ्य NTA Public Notice दिनांक 14.11.2026 और SHRESHTA (NETS) 2027 Information Bulletin (nta.ac.in) से लिए गए हैं।
steps: nta.ac.in पर SHRESHTA (NETS) – 2027 का Public Notice (14.11.2026) और Information Bulletin पढ़ें।
exams.nta.nic.in/shreshta-nets-2027-application-form/ पर 'New Registration' से register करें।
Form भरें, photo/signature और documents upload करें।
Form submit करें — कोई fee नहीं है (Nil)।
Correction window 2–4 दिसंबर 2026 में गलती सुधारें; admit card 3 जनवरी 2027 से download करें।
hi.tagline: SC और DNT विद्यार्थियों के लिए Class 9 और Class 11 में प्रतिष्ठित निजी आवासीय विद्यालयों में प्रवेश की National Entrance Test — लगभग 2,400 सीटें, पूरा खर्च केंद्र सरकार वहन करती है — 14–30 नवंबर 2026 तक apply करें, कोई fee नहीं; exam 10 जनवरी 2027।

note_en: This is an entrance test for admission to Class 9 and Class 11 in reputed private residential schools for meritorious Scheduled Caste (SC) and De-notified Tribe (DNT) students — it is NOT a job recruitment. About 2,400 students are selected and the entire cost of education is funded by the Central Government.
note_hi: यह प्रतिष्ठित निजी आवासीय विद्यालयों में कक्षा 9 और कक्षा 11 में प्रवेश के लिए मेधावी अनुसूचित जाति (SC) और विमुक्त जनजाति (DNT) विद्यार्थियों के लिए एक प्रवेश परीक्षा है — यह कोई नौकरी की भर्ती नहीं है। लगभग 2,400 विद्यार्थियों का चयन होता है और शिक्षा का पूरा खर्च केंद्र सरकार वहन करती है।

Date of birth proof and ID proof

donts: Do not apply with Class 10 alone — PUC / Class 12 or an equivalent is compulsory.
Do not apply if your PUC result is still awaited — the marksheet must be in hand by 22 December 2026.
Do not ignore the physical standards — the endurance run and PET are qualifying, and failing any of them ends the candidature.
Do not wait for the last day — apply by 22 December and pay the fee by 23 December 2026.
dos: Apply only through the KEA portal (cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea) between 23 November and 22 December 2026 — no other mode is accepted.
Check the physical standards before applying — height, chest, weight, eye vision and the defect list are all qualifying.
Pay the fee online by 23 December 2026 (₹750 / ₹500 / ₹250 by category) and keep the payment receipt.
Prepare for the written test at II PUC level: Mathematics 40 marks + General Knowledge 60 marks, 100 questions in 2 hours.
eligibility: Indian citizen.
PUC (2nd PUC / Class 12) from a recognised board, or an equivalent qualification, held by 22 December 2026.
Age 18 years or above as on 22 December 2026, within the category maximum (32 / 35 / 37 years).
Mentally and physically fit, and free of the disqualifying physical defects listed in the notification.
Read Notification No. KFD/HOFF/B9(RCT)/8/2026-PnR-KFD fully on aranya.gov.in before applying.

₹500 for SC/ST/Category-I, Ex-Servicemen and Transgender candidates (₹250 application fee + ₹250 processing fee).
₹250 for Persons with Disabilities (processing fee only).
Pay online only — UPI, NEFT, Credit/Debit Card or Internet Banking — by 23 December 2026. The fee is non-refundable.

en.name: Karnataka Forest Beat Forester (Forest Guard) Recruitment 2026
en.qual: PUC (2nd PUC / Class 12) from a recognised board, or an equivalent qualification, to be held by 22 December 2026
specs: 355 posts of Gasthu Aranya Palaka — called 'Aranya Rakshaka' (Forest Guard) in the recruitment rules — Group 'C', Residual Parent Cadre (RPC / Non-HK): 320 current + 35 backlog, across 11 forest circles of Karnataka.

Circle-wise current vacancies (320): Bengaluru 20, Chamarajanagar 75, Chikkamagaluru 27, Dharwad 3, Hassan 18, Kanara 33, Kodagu 26, Mangaluru 32, Mysuru 28, Shivamogga 58. Backlog (35): Bengaluru 5, Ballari 1, Chamarajanagar 3, Chikkamagaluru 2, Kanara 12, Kodagu 1, Mangaluru 4, Mysuru 1, Shivamogga 6.

Age as on 22 December 2026: minimum 18 years. Maximum — General Merit 32 years; Category 2A/2B/3A/3B 35 years; SC/ST/Category-I 37 years. These limits already include a one-time 5-year relaxation. Ex-Servicemen: category maximum + years of service + 3 years. Serving honorarium Forest Guards with 5+ years' continuous service: maximum 43 years (General), 46 years (2A/2B/3A/3B), 48 years (SC/ST/Category-I).

Qualification: PUC (2nd PUC / Class 12) from the Karnataka Pre-University Board, or an equivalent — CBSE/ICSE Class 12, other State Boards' Class 12, NIOS Higher Secondary, 3-year Diploma, 2-year ITI/JOC course, or GTTC 3+1 diploma treated as a 3-year diploma. Candidates awaiting results or without the marksheet by the last date are NOT eligible. Class 10 alone is not enough.

Physical standards (Physical Standard Test): Men — height minimum 163 cm (152 cm for ST-Local Forest Dwelling Tribe candidates); chest minimum 79 cm normal with 5 cm expansion (74 cm normal, 5 cm expansion for ST-LFT). Women — height minimum 150 cm (145 cm for ST-LFT); minimum weight 40 kg (38 kg for ST-LFT). Eye vision: distant vision better eye 6/6 or worse eye 6/9 (with or without glasses); near vision better eye 0/6 or worse eye 0/8; colour-vision test compulsory. Disqualifying defects: knock-knees, bow legs, flat feet, varicose veins, speech/hearing impediment, hydrocele (men), vision / colour blindness / night blindness.

Selection: (1) Shortlisting on PUC marks in 1:20 ratio (posts:candidates), circle-wise, for the physical tests. (2) Physical Standard Test. (3) Physical Endurance Test: Men 1600 m run in 07 minutes; Women and Ex-Servicemen 1000 m run in 06 minutes — fail means out. (4) Physical Efficiency Test: 5 events, pass at least 3 — 100 m run (Men 15 sec / Women 18.5 sec), High Jump (Men 1.20 m / Women 0.90 m), Long Jump (Men 3.80 m / Women 2.50 m), Shotput (Men 16 lb: 5.60 m / Women 8 lb: 3.76 m), 800 m run Men 2 min 50 sec, 200 m run Women 40 sec. (5) Written test — offline OMR, objective type: ONE paper, General Knowledge & Mathematics, 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours; Mathematics 40 marks, General Knowledge 60 marks (II PUC level); question paper in Kannada and English only; 1 mark per correct answer, −0.25 for a wrong / multiple / blank answer. (6) Document verification.
Dates: online application 23 November–22 December 2026; fee payment by 23 December 2026. Physical test and written exam dates to be announced.

All facts above are from Notification No. KFD/HOFF/B9(RCT)/8/2026-PnR-KFD dated 17.11.2026 (46-page Kannada notification, aranya.gov.in). The notification PDF link on aranya.gov.in is session-bound, so the notice link is kept null and the notification number above is the citable reference.
steps: aranya.gov.in par Notification No. KFD/HOFF/B9(RCT)/8/2026-PnR-KFD (17.11.2026) padhen.
cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea par Beat Forester (RPC) notification select karke 'New Registration' se register karen.
Form bharen, photo/signature aur documents upload karen.
₹750 / ₹500 / ₹250 fee online bharen — 23 December 2026 tak.
Form submit karen aur application ka printout save karen.

आयु 22 दिसंबर 2026 को: न्यूनतम 18 वर्ष। अधिकतम — General Merit 32 वर्ष; Category 2A/2B/3A/3B 35 वर्ष; SC/ST/Category-I 37 वर्ष। इन limits में one-time 5-year relaxation शामिल है। भूतपूर्व सैनिक: category maximum + सेवा के वर्ष + 3 वर्ष। 5+ साल की निरंतर सेवा वाले मानदेय वन रक्षकों (अरण्य प्रेरक) के लिए अधिकतम 43 वर्ष (General), 46 वर्ष (2A/2B/3A/3B), 48 वर्ष (SC/ST/Category-I)।

Qualification: कर्नाटक Pre-University Board से PUC (2nd PUC / Class 12), या समकक्ष — CBSE/ICSE Class 12, अन्य State Boards की Class 12, NIOS Higher Secondary, 3-year Diploma, 2-year ITI/JOC course, या GTTC 3+1 diploma (3-year diploma के समकक्ष)। जिनका result अभी awaited है या जिनके पास आखिरी तारीख तक marksheet नहीं है, वे eligible नहीं हैं। सिर्फ Class 10 काफी नहीं है।

शारीरिक मानक (Physical Standard Test): पुरुष — height न्यूनतम 163 cm (ST-Local Forest Dwelling Tribe उम्मीदवारों के लिए 152 cm); chest सामान्य स्थिति में न्यूनतम 79 cm, expansion 5 cm (ST-LFT के लिए 74 cm, expansion 5 cm)। महिला — height न्यूनतम 150 cm (ST-LFT के लिए 145 cm); न्यूनतम वजन 40 kg (ST-LFT के लिए 38 kg)। Eye vision: distant vision better eye 6/6 या worse eye 6/9 (चश्मे सहित या बिना); near vision better eye 0/6 या worse eye 0/8; colour-vision test अनिवार्य। अयोग्य ठहराने वाले दोष: knock-knees, bow legs, flat feet, varicose veins, बोलने/सुनने में बाधा, hydrocele (पुरुष), vision / colour blindness / night blindness।

चयन: (1) PUC marks के आधार पर 1:20 ratio (पद:उम्मीदवार) में shortlisting, circle-wise, physical tests के लिए। (2) Physical Standard Test। (3) Physical Endurance Test: पुरुष 1600 m दौड़ 07 मिनट में; महिलाएँ और भूतपूर्व सैनिक 1000 m दौड़ 06 मिनट में — fail होने पर बाहर। (4) Physical Efficiency Test: 5 events, कम से कम 3 में pass — 100 m दौड़ (पुरुष 15 sec / महिला 18.5 sec), High Jump (पुरुष 1.20 m / महिला 0.90 m), Long Jump (पुरुष 3.80 m / महिला 2.50 m), Shotput (पुरुष 16 lb: 5.60 m / महिला 8 lb: 3.76 m), 800 m दौड़ पुरुष 2 min 50 sec, 200 m दौड़ महिला 40 sec। (5) Written test — offline OMR, objective type: एक paper, General Knowledge & Mathematics, 100 प्रश्न, 100 अंक, 2 घंटे; Mathematics 40 अंक, General Knowledge 60 अंक (II PUC level); प्रश्न-पत्र सिर्फ Kannada और English में; सही जवाब पर 1 अंक, गलत / multiple / blank जवाब पर −0.25। (6) Document verification।
Dates: ऑनलाइन आवेदन 23 नवंबर – 22 दिसंबर 2026; fee payment 23 दिसंबर 2026 तक। Physical test और written exam की तारीखें बाद में घोषित होंगी।

specs: 19 Specialist Medical Officers, all at CRPF Composite Hospitals, on contractual basis (walk-in interview notice dated 16/11/2026, signed by DIG (Recruitment), Directorate General, CRPF). By specialty: Surgeon 9, Radiology 4, Ophthalmology 2, Anaesthesia 2, Obstetrics & Gynaecology 2.

Venue-wise (Composite Hospital, post): Prayagraj — Surgeon 1; Avadi — Surgeon 1; Raipur — Surgeon 1; Bhopal — Surgeon 1 + Ophthalmology 1; Muzaffarpur — Surgeon 1; Rampur — Surgeon 1 + Anaesthesia 1; Ranchi — Surgeon 1 + Obs & Gynae 1 + Anaesthesia 1; Silchar — Surgeon 1 + Obs & Gynae 1; Hyderabad — Radiology 1; Jammu — Radiology 1; Bhubaneswar — Radiology 1; Jagdalpur — Radiology 1; Pune — Ophthalmology 1; Gandhinagar — Surgeon 1.
Remuneration: Rs. 85,000 per month (consolidated) for Specialist Medical Officers. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.
Age: below 70 years as on the date of the walk-in interview, for Male & Female candidates. No age relaxation is stated in the notice.

Eligibility: (A) A recognised medical qualification of the allopathic system included in the First or Second Schedule or Part-II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956; (B) completion of compulsory rotating internship; (C) PG Degree/Diploma in the concerned specialty (Section 'A' or 'B' in Schedule-I or equivalent) AND 1.5 years' experience in the specialty after a PG Degree, or 2.5 years' experience after a PG Diploma. 'MBBS + PG Diploma' alone is not enough — the experience condition also applies.
Selection: walk-in interview at 0900 hrs, followed by Medical Examination. No written test is mentioned.

Dates: walk-in interview on 15/12/2026 at 0900 hrs at most centres — EXCEPT Avadi (Sl. 02), Jagdalpur (Sl. 12) and Gandhinagar (Sl. 14), whose date was moved to 17/12/2026 at 0900 hrs by the Corrigendum/Addendum dated 18/11/2026 ('Considering the physical availability of POs at Interview Centres'). There is NO online apply start/last date.

How to attend: carry an application in plain paper superscribing the name of the post applied for, documents in original and photocopies (Degree, Age Proof & Experience certificate etc.), and three passport-size recent photographs. Helpline in the notice: 011-24368630.

All facts above are from the walk-in interview notice dated 16/11/2026 and the Corrigendum/Addendum dated 18/11/2026 (rect.crpf.gov.in). No advt. number is printed on the notice — it is identified only by its title and date.

Remuneration (consolidated fixed monthly, all inclusive): Senior Consultant (Law) Rs. 1,75,000; Consultant (Horticulture, Content Writer, Graphic Designer, Video Editor) Rs. 1,50,000 each; Consultant (Bird & Wildlife) Rs. 1,20,000; Junior Consultants Rs. 1,00,000 each; Associate Consultants Rs. 70,000 each.

Age — upper limits per post, cut-off 27.10.2026 (for age, qualification and experience; the corrigenda say all other terms remain the same): 30 years — Associate Consultant (Bird & Wildlife), Associate Consultant (Obstacle Management), Associate Consultant (Technical); 35 years — Junior Consultant (Clinical Psychologist), Junior Consultant (Airport Systems), Junior Consultant (Obstacle Management), Junior Consultant (Technical); 40 years — Consultant (Bird & Wildlife), Consultant (Horticulture), Consultant (Content Writer), Consultant (Graphic Designer), Consultant (Video Editor); 45 years — Senior Consultant (Law). NOTE: for Junior Consultant (Technical) the qualification cell in the advertisement's table is blank — only '3–5 years post qualification experience in the field of Mechanical / Automobile Engineering' is printed for that row; the Mechanical/Automobile degree is printed against the Associate post.

Selection: Document Verification and Interview. Candidates must obtain a minimum of 50 marks in the Interview, based upon merit ranking. Document Verification / Interview dates: 'Will be intimated later'.

Addendum-01 (06-11-2026): the place of engagement of Junior Consultant (Technical) and Associate Consultant (Technical) will be at Vijayawada Airport, Tirupati Airport, Madurai Airport and Rajahmundry Airport. All other terms unchanged.

en.name: ICMR Scientist-D (Non-Medical) Recruitment 2026
en.qual: Master's degree in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences from a recognised university OR Pharm-D recognised by UGC/PCI, with 8 years' essential experience in the relevant field
specs: 1 vacancy — Scientist-D (Non-Medical) — initial posting at ICMR-National Institute for Research in Bacterial Infections (NIRBI), Kolkata, with all-India transfer liability under the Council.
Pay: Level 12 of the Pay Matrix, ₹78,800–₹2,09,200 (7th CPC) plus usual allowances as admissible to ICMR employees. Appointment on REGULAR basis under Direct Recruitment.
Advt. No. ICMR/Rectt/Sc-D/02/2026-RPCell. The notification PDF is digitally signed 20.11.2026; no separate printed advertisement date appears on it.

Essential qualification: Master's degree from a recognised university in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences OR Pharm-D degree recognised by UGC/PCI. Essential experience: 8 years in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences, relevant to the job, in Govt. / Public sector / Private institutions.

How experience is counted: PhD counts as 4 years' experience, MD/MS as 3 years, MVSc as 2 years; MPH / M.Tech / ME counts as no experience. The period spent obtaining the minimum essential qualification does not count towards experience.

Desirable: PhD from a recognised university in Biophysics / Molecular Biology / Biochemistry, with experience in Research & Development in Biomedical Sciences — research on structural biology using Cryo-Electron Microscope (Cryo-EM) for biological specimens, in particular macromolecular complexes, with Cryo-EM reconstruction algorithms and computational skills.

Age: upper age limit 45 years as on the closing date (31 December 2026), relaxable in accordance with Government of India instructions. Eligibility (age, qualification, experience) is judged on the last date of submission.

Selection: Computer-Based Test (MCQs) or interview, or both. The CBT, if conducted, is qualifying in nature and based on research methods, techniques and areas of expertise relevant to the post. Shortlisted candidates may be further shortlisted if numbers are high.

specs: 2 posts — Deputy Manager (Finance)/E1, 01, Mumbai; Deputy Manager (Mechanical)/E1, 01, Paradip. Vacancy Circular No. 12/2026 dated 04.11.2026; closing date 04.12.2026.

Terms of appointment: ON ABSORPTION. Monthly remuneration: IDA Scale of Pay Rs. 40,000–1,40,000/- plus applicable allowances and PRP (for IDA as per policy). The officer can, however, be posted anywhere in India.

Age: up to 32 years as on 04.12.2026. Age relaxation is available only for employees presently working on the rolls of IPRCL, to the extent of their service period rendered in IPRCL. No SC/ST/OBC age relaxation is stated.
Essential Educational Qualification: for Deputy Manager (Finance)/E1 — full-time Graduate plus CA/ICWAI. For Deputy Manager (Mechanical)/E1 — full-time Degree in Mechanical Engineering.

Required Experience — Finance: experience in Finance & Accounts with IND-AS, Finalization of Accounts, GST, Income Tax, Internal & Statutory Audit, Banking and Treasury, Billing, Vetting of proposals, with knowledge of Tally, MS Office, ERP, Tenders & Contracts etc.

Required Experience — Mechanical: experience of all phases of project i.e. planning, procurement of trainsets/wagons/rolling stock, tender document preparation, bidding execution, commissioning, post commissioning, knowledge of testing, managing operations, maintenance of locomotives/wagons in Railway projects, Mechanical engineering related infrastructure works such as Metro / MRTS / Railways / Elevated Roads / Ropeways etc.

Eligibility criteria: the applicant must be an officer presently working on regular (on absorption) or contract basis in Railways, other Government departments, Central PSUs, Ports, JV companies under Government control / private companies, meeting the pay-scale criteria: CDA — PB-2 + GP 4200/- (pre-revised 6th CPC), revised to Pay Matrix Level 6 under 7th CPC, for 2 years; IDA — Rs. 16,400–40,500 (pre-revised 2nd PRC) revised to Rs. 40,000–1,40,000 under 3rd PRC for 2 years, OR Rs. 12,600–32,500 revised to Rs. 30,000–1,20,000 for 2 years; Private sector — officer at Deputy Manager equivalent and above drawing minimum gross Rs. 50,000 per month, with at least 04 years' overall Executive (Officer) level service experience, working in a company with sales turnover of at least Rs. 75 Crores in the preceding Financial Year. For Mechanical, IDA officers may alternatively have at least 04 years in consolidated remuneration (non-IDA) in a supervisory role as Project Engineer / Site Engineer / Jr. Site Engineer / Sr. Site Engineer etc. in the concerned discipline in a PSU / Govt. Company / J.V. Company under Govt. control. Higher grade pay granted under ACP/MACP/NF by the parent department is not counted.
Crucial date for determining eligibility with reference to age, essential educational qualification, length of experience etc. is 04.12.2026.

Selection: shortlisting based on eligibility/experience in the relevant field, followed by Personal Interview (at the Corporate Office, or through video-conference, or at any other location at IPRCL's discretion). If 05 or more eligible candidates apply for a vacancy, shortlisting is in the ratio of 1:5. Intimation for the interview is sent by e-mail and posted on the IPRCL website. Travelling expenses for the interview are paid as per Company Policy. Selected candidates must be physically and medically fit, with a medical examination after selection.

How to apply: NO online form. Duly filled application as per Annexure-II (for absorption) along with enclosures, superscribing 'Application for the post of ____' on the envelope, to be sent by post / courier or dropped personally to Chief General Manager (HR), Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd (IPRCL), 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P. Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai-400010, by 04.12.2026. Officers serving in Railways / Govt. departments / Central PSUs / Ports / JV companies must apply through proper channel, submit copies of the last 05 years' APARs, and produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview.
All facts above are from Vacancy Circular No. 12/2026 dated 04.11.2026 (8 pages, iprcl.in).
